  {T : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.LeafValues},
  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 < T.hessFloor ι) →
    (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.hessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).hess) →
      (∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 ≤ T.curlHessFloor ι) →
        (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.curlHessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).curlHess) →
          (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, (T.localMatrix ι p).IsHermitian) →
            (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => T.localMatrix ι p i j) ∧
                  ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                    ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.coefPairValue (coef ι p) s v - T.boxPenalty ι s v) →
                (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                          0 ≤
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) -
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss (ch.curl ι p) (ch.product ι p)
                                      (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                  T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                              T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                    (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                        T.hessFloor (-ι) = T.hessFloor ι ∧
                          T.curlHessFloor (-ι) = T.curlHessFloor ι ∧
                            T.curlAbsorb (-ι) = T.curlAbsorb ι ∧
                              T.strainAbsorb (-ι) = T.strainAbsorb ι ∧ T.velocityAbsorb (-ι) = T.velocityAbsorb ι) →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
    (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤ h.ampGradW β y) →
      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
              h.ampVort β y) →
        (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                h.ampGradVort β y) →
          (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
            (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supGradVort y) →
              (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                  ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                        (m.epsP β).frame •
                          (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                            (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                    (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                          (m.muP β).frame •
                            (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                      (m.muP β).speed y) →
                  (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                      ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                        ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                          (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^ 2 ≤
                            ratio *
                              ∑ β,
                                |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                  (m.muP β).wt y) →
                        0 ≤ ratio →
                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space), m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup
                                  ratio

declarations.type:
{A B : Type} →
  [inst : Fintype A] →
    [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
      {T : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.SignedTree A B} →
        {ν : T.Node} →
          {D : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ComplexNodeData A B} →
            {E F : Matrix D.Index D.Index ℝ} →
              {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure T ν D E F → Sort u} →
                (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure T ν D E F) →
                  ((coordinates : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.IsCoordinateOn D.coords D.pivot) →
                      (factor_nonneg : 0 ≤ D.factor) →
                        (input_self_adjoint : D.input.conjTranspose = D.input) →
                          (base_self_adjoint : D.base.conjTranspose = D.base) →
                            (weight_pos : ∀ (j : D.Index), 0 < D.weight j) →
                              (input_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ E i j) →
                                (input_error_symm : E.transpose = E) →
                                  (front_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                                    (front_error_symm : F.transpose = F) →
                                      (row_bound :
                                          ∀ (i : D.Index),
                                            D.weight i *
                                                ∑ j,
                                                  (‖Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexSlackRemainder D.input D.base
                                                            D.pivot D.pivotValue D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ +
                                                        E i j +
                                                      F i j) /
                                                    D.weight j ≤
                                              D.radius i) →
                                        (input_lower :
                                            ∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                                  (D.factor •
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix
                                                      D.input)
                                                  x ≤
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x +
                                                  D.factor *
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i =>
                                                      ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec
                                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                                          (front_upper :
                                              ∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                                      (D.factor •
                                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix
                                                          (D.base -
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexDiagonal
                                                              (Finset.univ \ D.pivot) D.radius))
                                                      x +
                                                    D.factor *
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i =>
                                                        ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec
                                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                                            (pivots_eq : T.pivots ν = D.coords.pivotImage D.pivot) →
                                              (slack_le :
                                                  ∀ k ∈ T.pivots ν,
                                                    T.slack ν k ≤
                                                      D.factor *
                                                        D.coords.slackOn D.pivot (fun j => D.pivotValue j - D.radius j)
                                                          k) →
                                                (columns :
                                                    ∃ e,
                                                      Function.Injective e ∧
                                                        ∀ (c : D.Neg ⊕ D.Neg),
                                                          T.columnNode (e c) = ν ∧
                                                            T.column (e c) =
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realColumns D.coords.matrix
                                                                D.factor D.negColumns c) →
                                                  motive ⋯) →
                    motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CertificateClauses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k},
  (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
    0 ≤ d.stiffRadius →
      (∀ (j : Fin k), d.scale j ≠ 0) →
        d.weight ≤ d.weightMax →
          0 < d.multiplierWeight →
            0 ≤ d.coerciveL2 →
              0 ≤ d.coercivePin →
                0 ≤ d.rowBound →
                  0 ≤ d.gapSize →
                    0 ≤ d.formShift →
                      d.transferLoss < 1 →
                        d.coerciveL2 + d.rowBound ≤ (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.coerciveTotal →
                          0 < d.coerciveTotal →
                            0 ≤ d.actuatorBound →
                              0 ≤ d.modelFormBound →
                                d.modelFormBound + d.formShift ≤ d.formBound →
                                  0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                                    0 < d.supBound →
                                      (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.period q ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                        0 < d.twist →
                                          (d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                            (∑ i, Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2) →
                                              (∀ q ∈ d.params, 0 ≤ d.defectBound q ∧ 0 ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                      ENNReal.ofReal (d.defectBound q ^ 2)) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.rows (d.defect q) ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                    (∀ q ∈ d.params, d.defectBound q ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                      (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                          d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q + d.defectRowBound q +
                                                              d.coercivePin * Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                            (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                        2 * d.coerciveTotal * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                              d.supBound <
                                                            1 →
                                                          4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                (1 / d.weight +
                                                                      2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.formBound +
                                                                    2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                      (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) +
                                                                  2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) / d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                              d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                            4 *
                                                                      (1 / d.weight +
                                                                        2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.formBound) *
                                                                    d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                  4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                    (d.defectMax +
                                                                        2 * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                            d.sizeBound *
                                                                          d.supBound +
                                                                      2 * (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                        d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                d.supBound ^ 2 →
                                                              IsUnit d.frame →
                                                                (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                                                        ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            ENNReal.ofReal (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                          ENNReal.ofReal (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                  (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointL2 j) →
                                                                    (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                      (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →
                                                                        (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                              d.adjointQuad j * (2 * d.sizeBound) ^ 2 +
                                                                                    2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                      √(d.adjointDefect j ^ 2 +
                                                                                          (Breakdown.vecNorm
                                                                                                (d.actuatorAdjointError
                                                                                                  q j) /
                                                                                              d.multiplierWeight) ^
                                                                                            2) +
                                                                                  d.adjointOffset j ≤
                                                                                |d.scale j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                          0 ≤ d.stiffNorm →
                                                                            (∀ (x : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                                ∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                    (∑ i, d.frame i j * x i) ^ 2 ≤
                                                                                  d.stiffNorm ^ 2 * ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                              (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                  √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                        (∑ i,
                                                                                              d.frame i j *
                                                                                                d.multiplier q i -
                                                                                            d.scale j * q j) ^
                                                                                          2) ≤
                                                                                    d.stiffOffset) →
                                                                                2 * d.sizeBound * d.stiffNorm /
                                                                                        d.multiplierWeight +
                                                                                      d.stiffOffset ≤
                                                                                    d.stiffRadius →
                                                                                  (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                      4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 / d.weight <
                                                                                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral
                                                                                            fun σ y =>
                                                                                            Breakdown.matSq
                                                                                              (fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ)
                                                                                                y)).toReal) →
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellLayerSystem.CertificateClauses
                                                                                      d

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
    (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤ h.ampGradW β y) →
      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
              h.ampVort β y) →
        (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                h.ampGradVort β y) →
          (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
            (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supGradVort y) →
              (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                  ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                        (m.epsP β).frame •
                          (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                            (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                    (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                          (m.muP β).frame •
                            (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                      (m.muP β).speed y) →
                  (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                      ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                        ∃ Ωs > 0, ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes, Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                          (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^ 2 ≤
                            ratio *
                              ∑ β,
                                |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                  (m.muP β).wt y) →
                        0 ≤ ratio →
                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space), m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup
                                  ratio

      {ch : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges} →

          {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T → Sort u} →

              ((hessFloor_pos : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 < T.hessFloor ι) →
                  (hessFloor_le : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.hessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).hess) →
                    (curlHessFloor_nonneg : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 ≤ T.curlHessFloor ι) →
                      (curlHessFloor_le : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.curlHessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).curlHess) →
                        (matrix_hermitian : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, (T.localMatrix ι p).IsHermitian) →
                          (matrix_regular :
                              ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => T.localMatrix ι p i j) ∧
                                  ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
                            (matrix_le :
                                ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                    ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.coefPairValue (coef ι p) s v -
                                          T.boxPenalty ι s v) →
                              (pointwise :
                                  ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                          0 ≤
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) -
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss (ch.curl ι p)
                                                      (ch.product ι p) (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                                  T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                                              T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                                (charges_nonneg :
                                    ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                                  (symmetric :
                                      ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                        T.hessFloor (-ι) = T.hessFloor ι ∧
                                          T.curlHessFloor (-ι) = T.curlHessFloor ι ∧
                                            T.curlAbsorb (-ι) = T.curlAbsorb ι ∧

declarations.name: Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k} {j : Fin k} {r : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectEntry k},
  (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSet, d.radius i ≤ r.coordBound i) →
    (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ, d.scale i ≠ 0 ∧ |d.stiffRadius| ≤ |d.scale i| * r.coordBound i) →
      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms r.centrePotential r.centreNumbers →
        (∀ q ∈ d.params,
            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
              (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.centreResidual q) r.pinFlux r.centrePotential)
              r.centreNumbers.remainder) →
          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet, Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms (r.fittedPotential i) (r.fittedNumbers i)) →
            (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet,
                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.fittedResidual i) (fun x x_1 => 0)
                    (r.fittedPotential i))
                  (r.fittedNumbers i).remainder) →
              (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, 0 < r.freeWeight i) →
                0 ≤ r.freeValue →
                  0 ≤ r.freeDual →
                    (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                            (∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * ‖r.free q i σ y‖ ^ 2) * ‖r.field σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                          ENNReal.ofReal (r.freeValue ^ 2)) →
                      (∃ δ,
                          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ,
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                  (fun σ y =>
                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.transposeApply (fderiv ℝ (r.free q i σ) y) (r.field σ y))
                                  (δ i)) ∧
                            ∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * δ i ^ 2 ≤ r.freeDual ^ 2) →
                        Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative r.field)
                            r.timeDual →
                          0 ≤ r.pinError →
                            0 ≤ r.pinRound →
                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                    ‖∑ l, r.pinCoef l • (r.pins.potential l σ y - r.pins.generator l σ y)‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                  ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinError ^ 2) →
                                (∀ (c : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                        Breakdown.matSq
                                          (∑ l, c l • (d.pin l σ y - fderiv ℝ (r.pins.potential l σ) y))) ≤
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinRound ^ 2 * ∑ l, c l ^ 2)) →
                                  √(∑ l, r.pinCoef l ^ 2) ≤ r.pinCoefNorm →
                                    r.defectSum d.weight + r.pinCharge d.weight ≤ d.adjointDefect j →
                                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded d j r

declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S → Sort u} →
                  ((cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                      (row_map :
                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount)
                            (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                            S K x →
                              (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
                                (∑ ι,
                                      if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                                        ∑ d,
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                                              (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                                      else 0) +
                                    ∑ ι',
                                      ∑ d,
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K
                                              ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K
                                              ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
                                  ∑ l,
                                    x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                        ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                        (row_band :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                              ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                  (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p =
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
                          (row_tail :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                                      (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                                        ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                                          (D.mesh.box K).proj
                                            (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                            else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                            (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                            else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                            (fun p' =>
                                              ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                                            p) →
                            (partners_leak :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                  (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                              (leak_curl :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                      ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                            ∑ g,
                                              if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2
                                              else 0) +
                                          if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                            2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                              2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                                          else 0) ≤
                                        (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
                                (leak_vel :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                        ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                              ∑ g,
                                                if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then
                                                  (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2
                                                else 0) +
                                            if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                  ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                  (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                                            else 0) ≤
                                          (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                                  (tests_valid :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                                            (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                  ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                                                ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                                                  ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                                                  ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                                    (rows_groups_cover :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                            ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                              ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                                ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                                                  ∃ g,
                                                    ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧
                                                      ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                                      (sources_leak :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆
                                              (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                        (actuator_pos :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                          (actuator_kappa :
                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤
                                                  (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                                            (actuator_err :
                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                  ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                                      ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                        p.1 *
                                                          ∑ l,
                                                            ∑ c,
                                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                      (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                      ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                                                2 ≤
                                                    (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                              (actuator_model_regular :
                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                        (fun p =>
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                            ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                                        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                                        (fun p =>
                                                          p.1 *
                                                            ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                  ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c‖ ^
                                                              2)
                                                        (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                (actuator_off_rows :
                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                                      (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                                        ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K
                                                              ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K)
                                                                i)
                                                              (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K
                                                              ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K)
                                                                i)
                                                              ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                                  (pair_slack_pos :
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                        ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                                    (box_strain_pair :
                                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                            ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K →
                                                              R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                                      (costs_pos :
                                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                            0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                                              0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                                                0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                                                  0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                                      0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                                        (leak_budget :
                                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                                (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                                    ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                                            if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then 0
                                                                            else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                                          ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups
                                                                                  (P.potential K) ι).card /
                                                                            (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K
                                                                          (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                                      if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then
                                                                        1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                                      else 0) ≤
                                                                  1) →
                                                          (box_curl_rows :
                                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                                  2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                        ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                                            (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                                          2 +
                                                                      2 *
                                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R
                                                                            K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                        (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                    (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                                            (box_velocity_rows :
                                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                                    (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                            ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                                                (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                                              2 +
                                                                          2 *
                                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                            (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                                        if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                                          (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                                            (2 * Real.pi *
                                                                                  ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                                                (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                                              2
                                                                        else 0) ≤
                                                                      (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                                              (band_allowance_rows :
                                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                                      2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                              ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                                                  (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                                                2 +
                                                                            2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                  D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                              (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                          (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                                                  (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                                                2 +
                                                                            2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost
                                                                                  D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                                              (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                                          (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                                                (group_velocity :
                                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count)
                                                                      (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                                      ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                                        ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                                          (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                                              ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase
                                                                                    D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity
                                                                                    D K α p a) ≤
                                                                            (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2) →
                                                                  (group_curl :
                                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count)
                                                                        (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                                        ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                                          ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                                            (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                                                ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase
                                                                                      D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity
                                                                                      D K α p a) ≤
                                                                              (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →
                                                                    (period_box :
                                                                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                                            |1 / D.cert.period q -
                                                                                  D.model.periodInverse| ≤
                                                                              (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) →
                                                                      motive ⋯) →
                    (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S) → motive t

                R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b → R.testOf a = R.testOf b → R.realPart a = R.realPart b → a = b) →
            (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, 0 < R.testWeight K ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K ι ≤ tauMax) →
                (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K (-ι) = R.testWeight K ι) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                        R.testCount K (-ι) = R.testCount K ι ∧
                          ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                            ∀ (c : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K (-ι) i c) p =
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K ι i c) p)) →
                    (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                        R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b → R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf b → R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf a → R.realPart a = true) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                              ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                ∀ (part : Bool),
                                  (ι = -ι → part = true) →
                                    ∃ a,
                                      R.cellOf a = K ∧
                                        (R.labelOf a = ι ∨ R.labelOf a = -ι) ∧ R.testOf a = i ∧ R.realPart a = part) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              ↑p.1 * deriv (fun r => R.testValue M.box a 0 (r, p.2)) p.1 + R.testValue M.box a 0 p +
                                    Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth m (R.labelOf a)) *
                                      R.testValue M.box a 1 p +
                                  ↑p.1 * deriv (fun z => R.testValue M.box a 2 (p.1, z)) p.2 =
                                0) →
                            (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                (M.box (R.cellOf a)).IsAxis →
                                  p.1 = 0 → R.testValue M.box a 0 p = 0 ∧ R.testValue M.box a 1 p = 0) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, (R.testBlockMatrix M.box K ι).PosDef) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.IsRowValues M R m tauMax

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
        S K x →
          (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
            (∑ ι,
                  if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                    ∑ d,
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                          (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                  else 0) +
                ∑ ι',
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
              ∑ l,
                x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
          ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
              (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p = Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
            ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                  (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                      (D.mesh.box K).proj
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (fun p' =>
                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                        p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
              (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                  ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                        ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2 else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                          2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                      else 0) ≤
                    (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                    ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                          ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2 else 0) +
                        if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                            2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                        else 0) ≤
                      (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                            ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                          ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                        ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                          ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                            ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                              ∃ g, ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧ ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤ (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                  ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    p.1 *
                                      ∑ l,
                                        ∑ c,
                                          ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                  ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                            2 ≤
                                (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                    (fun p =>
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                    (fun p =>
                                      p.1 *
                                        ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p
                                              c‖ ^
                                          2)
                                    (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                    ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K → R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                          0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                            0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                              0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K, 0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                            (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                        if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then 0
                                                        else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                      ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups (P.potential K)
                                                              ι).card /
                                                        (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                  if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then 1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                  else 0) ≤
                                              1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                  2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                    (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                        ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                          2 +
                                                      2 *
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K)
                                                            ι *
                                                        (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                    if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                      (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                          2
                                                    else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                  2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                    2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                    ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                      (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                          ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K α p a) ≤
                                                        (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2) →
                                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                      ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                        (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                            ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K α p a) ≤
                                                          (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                        |1 / D.cert.period q - D.model.periodInverse| ≤
                                                          (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) →
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S
