declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
              ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                S K x →
                  ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                          (fun a b =>
                            1 / 2 *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                          0) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                    S K x →
                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p = 0) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                  ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                    (∃ g a b,
                        ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect] 0) →
                      ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                        0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                          (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                            ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                              (∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef fun p =>
                                      ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                    ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                      ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                        (∃ g a b,
                            ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                0) →
                          ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                            ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                        p.1 *
                                          ∑ a,
                                            ∑ b,
                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a
                                                    b‖ ^
                                                2 ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                    ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                      0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                        ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                          0 ≤ Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι) →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientConditions.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {E : Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientEntry C nE nM} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientConditions D E → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientConditions D E) →
              ((valid :
                    ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                      ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
                        (E.entry j).IsValidOn (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.azimuthOrder (E.modes j)
                          (E.region j)) →
                  (covers :
                      ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect → ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι ∉ D.mesh.band K) →
                            ∃ j, ι ∈ E.modes j ∧ p ∈ E.region j) →
                    (floor_bound :
                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                          ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
                            ∀ p ∈ E.region j,
                              -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).hess ∧
                                -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curlGrad ∧
                                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curl ∧
                                    -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧
                                      -E.floor ≤
                                        (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) *
                                          ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →
                      (resolved_valid :
                          ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                  (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ≤
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                          (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                            (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                              (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                                (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                                          (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                                (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
                        (resolved_floor :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                  -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ∧
                                    -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ∧
                                      -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ∧
                                        -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ∧
                                          -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity) →
                          motive ⋯) →
                motive t

        {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
          {g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {motive : Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g → Sort u} →
              ((measurable_velocity : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => v z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (measurable_gradient : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => G z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                    (measurable_secondDeriv :
                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => H z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                      (measurable_derivative :
                          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => g z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                        (periodic_velocity : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic v) →
                          (periodic_gradient : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic G) →
                            (periodic_secondDeriv : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic H) →
                              (periodic_derivative : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic g) →
                                (weak_gradient : ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (v σ) (G σ)) →
                                  (weak_secondDeriv :
                                      ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ),
                                        ∀ (j : Fin 3),
                                          Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                                            (H σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                                    (divergence_free :
                                        ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          ∑ i, ((G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)).ofLp i = 0) →
                                      (sixth_power :
                                          ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖v σ y‖ ^ 6) < ⊤) →
                                        (gradient_finite :
                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => Breakdown.matSq (G σ y)) < ⊤) →
                                          (sumSecondPartials_finite :
                                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                  ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H σ y)‖ ^ 2) <
                                                ⊤) →
                                            (derivative_finite :
                                                (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖g σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                                              (transport :
                                                  ∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                    Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestVector φ →
                                                      ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                          inner ℝ (v z.1 z.2)
                                                            (-(1 / P) • deriv (fun s => φ s z.2) z.1 - φ z.1 z.2 -
                                                              (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) =
                                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (g z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2)) →
                                                (invariant :
                                                    ∀ γ ∈ Γ,
                                                      ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                        v (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) = γ.1 (v z.1 z.2)) →

                                                (twist_pos : 0 < d.twist) →
                                                  (twist_mem :
                                                      d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                                    (actuator_norm :
                                                        (∑ i,
                                                            Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                              ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                          ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2)) →
                                                      (defect_nonneg :
                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                            0 ≤ d.defectBound q ∧ 0 ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                        (defect_l2 :
                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                  ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                ENNReal.ofReal (d.defectBound q ^ 2)) →
                                                          (defect_rows :
                                                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                d.rows (d.defect q) ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                            (defect_le :
                                                                ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.defectBound q ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                              (size :
                                                                  ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                    d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q +
                                                                          d.defectRowBound q +
                                                                        d.coercivePin *
                                                                          Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                                      (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                                (small_first :
                                                                    2 * d.coerciveTotal *
                                                                          Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                        d.supBound <
                                                                      1) →
                                                                  (small_second :
                                                                      4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                          (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                  d.formBound +
                                                                              2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) +
                                                                            2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) /
                                                                              d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                                        d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                    (small_third :
                                                                        4 *
                                                                                (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                  2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                    d.formBound) *
                                                                              d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                            4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                              (d.defectMax +
                                                                                  2 *
                                                                                        Breakdown.supBoundFactor
                                                                                          d.weight *
                                                                                      d.sizeBound *
                                                                                    d.supBound +
                                                                                2 *
                                                                                    (d.actuatorBound /
                                                                                      d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                                  d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                          d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                      (frame_unit : IsUnit d.frame) →
                                                                        (adjoint_l2 :
                                                                            ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                                                                  ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                      ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                        (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                                    ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                      (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                          (adjointL2_nonneg :

                                                                            (adjointDefect_nonneg :
                                                                                ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                  0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                              (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                                  ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                    0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →
                                                                                (adjoint_inclusion :
                                                                                    ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                      ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                        d.adjointQuad j *
                                                                                                (2 * d.sizeBound) ^ 2 +
                                                                                              2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                √(d.adjointDefect j ^
                                                                                                      2 +
                                                                                                    (Breakdown.vecNorm
                                                                                                          (d.actuatorAdjointError
                                                                                                            q j) /
                                                                                                        d.multiplierWeight) ^
                                                                                                      2) +
                                                                                            d.adjointOffset j ≤
                                                                                          |d.scale j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                                  (stiffNorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.stiffNorm) →
                                                                                    (stiff_norm :
                                                                                        ∀ (x : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                                          ∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                              (∑ i, d.frame i j * x i) ^
                                                                                                2 ≤
                                                                                            d.stiffNorm ^ 2 *
                                                                                              ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                                      (stiff_offset :
                                                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                            √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                                  (∑ i,
                                                                                                        d.frame i j *
                                                                                                          d.multiplier q
                                                                                                            i -
                                                                                                      d.scale j * q j) ^
                                                                                                    2) ≤
                                                                                              d.stiffOffset) →
                                                                                        (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                                            2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                    d.stiffNorm /
                                                                                                  d.multiplierWeight +
                                                                                                d.stiffOffset ≤
                                                                                              d.stiffRadius) →
                                                                                          (nontrivial :
                                                                                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                                4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 /
                                                                                                    d.weight <
                                                                                                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral
                                                                                                      ⋯).toReal) →
                                                                                            motive ⋯) →
          motive t

            (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), R.chargeLower ≤ R.charge p ∧ R.charge p ≤ R.chargeUpper) →
              (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount), LipschitzWith R.testSlope (R.test i)) →
                (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (z : ℝ), R.test i (R.inner, z) = 0 ∧ R.test i (R.outer, z) = 0) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (r : ℝ), R.test i (r, R.height) = 0) →
                    (∀ (s : Fin R.segmentCount), Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsPlaneSegment (R.segment s)) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {p : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialData} {C : ℝ},
  (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => p.theta z.1 z.2) →
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => p.phi z.1 z.2) →
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => p.flux z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => p.pressure z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
              Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (p.theta σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.theta σ) y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
            (∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
                Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (p.phi σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.phi σ) y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsWeakMatrixDivergence (p.flux σ)
                    (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.matrixDivergence (p.flux σ))) →
                (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsWeakScalarGradient (p.pressure σ) (Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ))) →
                  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                      ‖p.theta σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                        ‖fderiv ℝ (p.theta σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3 ∧
                          ‖p.phi σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ∧
                            ‖fderiv ℝ (p.phi σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                              ‖p.flux σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧ |p.pressure σ y| ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2) →
                    (∀ (σ : ℝ),
                        ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.theta σ) y)‖ ≤
                              C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 4 ∧
                            ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.phi σ) y)‖ ≤
                                C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3 ∧
                              ‖y‖ * ‖Breakdown.AdjointDefect.matrixDivergence (p.flux σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                                ‖y‖ * ‖Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ) y‖ ≤ C ∧
                                  ‖y‖ ^ 3 * ‖Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ) y‖ ≤ C) →
                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData p C

                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highOwnAmount D K (P.potential K) (D.mesh.resolved K)

        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
            S K x →
              ∑ ι,
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι true /
                      (P.potential K).strainBalance ↑ι +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι false /
                      (P.potential K).velBalance ↑ι) ≤
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (P.potential K).portForm x) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, 0 < (P.potential K).strainBalance ι ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).velBalance ι) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                0 < (P.potential K).groupBalance i ∧
                  0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupStrain i ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupGrad i) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).length) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).epsLength) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                      (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(7 / 2) ∨ (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(9 / 2)) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsStrain ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsGrad) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                            (R.leaves K).strainAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).strainBalance ι +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                  (2 * (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                    3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) ≤
                              (A.blocks K).potentialStrainCost ι) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                              (R.leaves K).velocityAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).velBalance ι +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                    (3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) ≤
                                (A.blocks K).potentialVelCost ι) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                              α ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels ↔
                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic D.azimuthOrder α ∈ D.givenLabels) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                    S K x →
                                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 12),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).potentialSource ι') x p
                                            j =
                                          ∑ ι,
                                            ∑ j',
                                              (P.potential K).couplingModel (ι' - ↑ι) p j j' *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.lowProfile D R K ι
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperPart D R K (P.potential K) x) p
                                                  j') →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K) (j : Fin 12),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                                        (A.blocks K).potentialSource ι d p j) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    (D.modelErrors K).strainHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highStrain ∧
                                      (D.modelErrors K).vorticityGradHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highGrad) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      0 < (P.potential K).youngCurl ∧
                                        0 < (P.potential K).youngStrain ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).youngVel) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),

                                                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
                                              ((⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) *

                                                    if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                                                (⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                                (P.potential K).longGrad) /

                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), Disjoint (A.blocks K).leakModes (D.mesh.band K)) →

                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),

                                                                                    (P.potential K) ι *

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {S : Fin k → Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} {ePair : Fin D.mesh.count → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin k), ∀ ι ∈ S i, ι ∈ R.pairLabels ∧ -ι ∈ R.pairLabels) →
    (∀ (i : Fin k) (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ (D.pinValues i).labels K, ι ∈ R.pairLabels ∧ -ι ∈ R.pairLabels) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
              R.pairProfile K (Sum.inr i) ι p a b =
                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.pin i) a b p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k),
            ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
              ι ∉ R.pairSlackLabels K →
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                    R.pairProfile K (Sum.inl i) ι p a b =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i))
                        a b p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin k ⊕ Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (a b : Fin 3),
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b)
                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                ∃ c, ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect, ‖R.pairProfile K g ι p a b‖ ≤ c) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), R.pairSlackLabels K ⊆ R.pairLabels) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                    ∑ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K,
                        (4 * R.pairSlackWeight K ι)⁻¹ *
                          ∑ i,
                            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                              p.1 *
                                ∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    ‖R.pairProfile K (Sum.inl i) ι p a b -
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι
                                            (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i)) a b p‖ ^
                                      2 ≤
                      ePair K) →
                  Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.IsPairSurrogate D R S ePair

  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 < T.hessFloor ι) →
    (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.hessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).hess) →
      (∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 ≤ T.curlHessFloor ι) →
        (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.curlHessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).curlHess) →
          (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, (T.localMatrix ι p).IsHermitian) →
            (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => T.localMatrix ι p i j) ∧
                  ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                    ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.coefPairValue (coef ι p) s v - T.boxPenalty ι s v) →
                (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                          0 ≤
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) -
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss (ch.curl ι p) (ch.product ι p)
                                      (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                  T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                              T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                  (∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                    (∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                        T.hessFloor (-ι) = T.hessFloor ι ∧
                          T.curlHessFloor (-ι) = T.curlHessFloor ι ∧

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {E : Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientEntry C nE nM},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
      ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
        (E.entry j).IsValidOn (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.azimuthOrder (E.modes j) (E.region j)) →
    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect → ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K ∧ ι ∉ D.mesh.band K) →
            ∃ j, ι ∈ E.modes j ∧ p ∈ E.region j) →
      (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
          ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
            ∀ p ∈ E.region j,
              -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).hess ∧
                -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curlGrad ∧
                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curl ∧
                    -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧
                      -E.floor ≤
                        (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →
        (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ≤
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                          D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                            D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                              D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                                D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                          (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q)
                                D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                  -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ∧
                    -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ∧
                      -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ∧
                        -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ∧
                          -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity) →
            Breakdown.CertCell.CoefficientConditions D E

  {X : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.ExteriorCover C nE nM},

        ∀ (j : Fin X.pointCount),
          Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsOffModeCondition (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn
            (D.charges none) D.azimuthOrder (X.pointConditions j)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin X.rayCount), (X.rayConditions i).charges = X.charges) →
        (∀ (j : Fin X.pointCount), (X.pointConditions j).charges = X.charges) →
          (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, ι ∈ X.modes a) →
            X.charges.Covers (D.charges none) Set.univ (D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane) →
              (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ X.charges.curlCharge p ∧ 0 ≤ X.charges.gradCharge p ∧ 0 ≤ X.charges.velCharge p) →
                (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane ⊆ ⋃ a ∈ X.parts ι, X.region a) →
                  (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                      ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, ∀ b ∈ X.parts ι, a ≠ b → MeasureTheory.volume (X.region a ∩ X.region b) = 0) →
                    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, X.region a ⊆ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin X.rayCount ⊕ Fin X.pointCount), MeasurableSet (X.region a)) →
                        (Measurable X.charges.curlCharge ∧
                            Measurable X.charges.gradCharge ∧
                              Measurable X.charges.velCharge ∧
                                ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                  Measurable ((D.charges none).curl ι) ∧
                                    Measurable ((D.charges none).product ι) ∧
                                      Measurable ((D.charges none).gradient ι) ∧

                          (∃ c,

                                |X.charges.curlCharge p| ≤ c ∧

                                          |(D.charges none).curl ι p| ≤ c ∧
                                            |(D.charges none).product ι p| ≤ c ∧
                                              |(D.charges none).gradient ι p| ≤ c ∧
                                                (D.charges none).gradient ι p * (D.charges none).length ι p ≤ c ∧
                                                  (D.charges none).gradient ι p * ((D.charges none).length ι p)⁻¹ ≤ c) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.IsPerturbation.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry} {P : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => v z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => G z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => H z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => g z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic v →
            Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic G →
              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic H →
                Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic g →
                  (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (v σ) (G σ)) →
                    (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ),
                        ∀ (j : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                            (H σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                      (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ((G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)).ofLp i = 0) →
                        (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖v σ y‖ ^ 6) < ⊤) →
                          (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => Breakdown.matSq (G σ y)) < ⊤ →
                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H σ y)‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖g σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                (∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                    Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestVector φ →
                                      ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                          inner ℝ (v z.1 z.2)
                                            (-(1 / P) • deriv (fun s => φ s z.2) z.1 - φ z.1 z.2 -
                                              (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) =
                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (g z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2)) →
                                  (∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), v (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) = γ.1 (v z.1 z.2)) →
                                    Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ProfileShapeEntry k}
  {Pr : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.PressureShapeEntry k}
  {Z : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.AdjointShapeEntry k}
  {O : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry k},
  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, 1 / D.cert.period q = O.freqCentre + ∑ i, q i * O.freqTangent i) →
    (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, ∀ (l : Fin k), D.cert.multiplier q l = O.multCentre l + ∑ i, q i * O.multTangent i l) →
      (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
          |O.offsetCentre j -
                (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multCentre l -
                  Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                    (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.centreCoefficient D R Pr O)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
            O.centreErr j) →
        (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
            ∀ (i : Fin k),
              |O.offsetLinear j i -
                    (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multTangent i l -
                      Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                        (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.linearCoefficient D R Pr O i)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                O.linearErr j i) →
          (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
              ∀ (i l : Fin k),
                i ≤ l →
                  |O.offsetQuad j i l +
                        Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                          (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.quadraticCoefficient R O i l)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j))| ≤
                    O.quadErr j i l) →
            0 ≤ O.farDefect →
              (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet, 0 ≤ O.farAdjoint j) →
                (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                        if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then ‖D.cert.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
                      ENNReal.ofReal (O.farDefect ^ 2)) →
                  (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                      (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                          if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then
                            ‖Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j) σ y‖ ^ 2
                          else 0) ≤
                        ENNReal.ofReal (O.farAdjoint j ^ 2)) →
                    (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,

                        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,

                            ∃ j, ι ∈ E.modes j ∧ p ∈ E.region j) →
                    (floor_bound :
                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                          ∀ (j : Fin E.count),
                            ∀ p ∈ E.region j,
                              -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).hess ∧
                                -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curlGrad ∧
                                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).curl ∧
                                    -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧

                                          ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →

                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),

                                ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,

                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)

                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                            (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
      S K x →
        (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
          (∑ ι,
                if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                else 0) +
              ∑ ι',
                ∑ d,
                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
            ∑ l,
              x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)

declarations.type:
{rowCount : ℕ} →
  {M : Breakdown.CertCell.CellMesh} →
    {R : Breakdown.CertCell.RowValues M.count rowCount} →
      {m : ℕ} →
        {tauMax : ℝ} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.IsRowValues M R m tauMax → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.IsRowValues M R m tauMax) →
              ((mesh_valid : Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh M) →
                  (azimuth_pos : 0 < m) →
                    (row_tested : ∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a ∈ M.tested (R.cellOf a)) →
                      (test_index : ∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.testOf a < R.testCount (R.cellOf a) (R.labelOf a)) →
                        (rows_distinct :
                            ∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                              R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                                R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b →
                                  R.testOf a = R.testOf b → R.realPart a = R.realPart b → a = b) →
                          (weight_pos : ∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, 0 < R.testWeight K ι) →
                            (weight_le : ∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K ι ≤ tauMax) →
                              (weight_neg :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K (-ι) = R.testWeight K ι) →
                                (tests_conj :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                                        R.testCount K (-ι) = R.testCount K ι ∧
                                          ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                            ∀ (c : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K (-ι) i c) p =
                                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K ι i c)
                                                    p)) →
                                  (rows_one_member :
                                      ∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                                        R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                                          R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf b → R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b) →
                                    (zero_label_real :
                                        ∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf a → R.realPart a = true) →
                                      (rows_complete :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                                              ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                                ∀ (part : Bool),
                                                  (ι = -ι → part = true) →
                                                    ∃ a,
                                                      R.cellOf a = K ∧
                                                        (R.labelOf a = ι ∨ R.labelOf a = -ι) ∧
                                                          R.testOf a = i ∧ R.realPart a = part) →
                                        (test_solenoidal :
                                            ∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              ↑p.1 * deriv (fun r => R.testValue M.box a 0 (r, p.2)) p.1 +
                                                      R.testValue M.box a 0 p +
                                                    Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth m (R.labelOf a)) *
                                                      R.testValue M.box a 1 p +
                                                  ↑p.1 * deriv (fun z => R.testValue M.box a 2 (p.1, z)) p.2 =
                                                0) →
                                          (test_axis :
                                              ∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                                (M.box (R.cellOf a)).IsAxis →
                                                  p.1 = 0 → R.testValue M.box a 0 p = 0 ∧ R.testValue M.box a 1 p = 0) →
                                            (block_posDef :
                                                ∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                                                  ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, (R.testBlockMatrix M.box K ι).PosDef) →
                                              motive ⋯) →
                motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] {T : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.SignedTree A B} {ν : T.Node}
  {D : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ComplexNodeData A B} {E F : Matrix D.Index D.Index ℝ},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.IsCoordinateOn D.coords D.pivot →
    0 ≤ D.factor →
      D.input.conjTranspose = D.input →
        D.base.conjTranspose = D.base →
          (∀ (j : D.Index), 0 < D.weight j) →
            (∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ E i j) →
              E.transpose = E →
                (∀ (i j : D.Index), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                  F.transpose = F →
                    (∀ (i : D.Index),
                        D.weight i *
                            ∑ j,
                              (‖Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexSlackRemainder D.input D.base D.pivot D.pivotValue
                                        D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ +
                                    E i j +
                                  F i j) /
                                D.weight j ≤
                          D.radius i) →
                      (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                              (D.factor • Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix D.input) x ≤
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x +
                              D.factor *
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i =>
                                  ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                        (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                  (D.factor •
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realRestriction D.coords.matrix
                                      (D.base -
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.complexDiagonal (Finset.univ \ D.pivot)
                                          D.radius))
                                  x +
                                D.factor *
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i =>
                                    ‖D.coords.matrix.mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.ofRealVec x) i‖) →
                          T.pivots ν = D.coords.pivotImage D.pivot →
                            (∀ k ∈ T.pivots ν,
                                T.slack ν k ≤
                                  D.factor * D.coords.slackOn D.pivot (fun j => D.pivotValue j - D.radius j) k) →
                              (∃ e,
                                  Function.Injective e ∧
                                    ∀ (c : D.Neg ⊕ D.Neg),
                                      T.columnNode (e c) = ν ∧
                                        T.column (e c) =
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.realColumns D.coords.matrix D.factor
                                            D.negColumns c) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesComplexNodeEnclosure T ν D E F

                        (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsCellModelSplit box m K deg W HW model err high long) →
                          ((velocity :
                                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K) W (model.velocity.field box m)
                                  high.velocity long.velocity err.velocityHigh long.errVelocity err.velocity) →
                              (vorticity :
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityOf W) (model.vorticity.field box m)
                                    high.vorticity long.vorticity err.vorticityHigh long.errVorticity err.vorticity) →
                                (strain :
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W) (model.strain.field box m)
                                      high.strain long.strain err.strainHigh long.errStrain err.strain) →
                                  (vorticityGrad :
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPartAE
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW)
                                        (model.vorticityGrad.field box m) high.vorticityGrad long.vorticityGrad
                                        err.vorticityGradHigh long.errVorticityGrad err.vorticityGrad) →
                                    (long_modes :
                                        ∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                                          |α.1| ≤ 2 * ↑long.cut →
                                            ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.velocity p a = 0) ∧
                                                (∀ (a : Fin 3),

                                                  (∀ (a b : Fin 3),

                                                    ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.vorticityGrad p (a, b) =
                                                        0) →
                                      (long_regular :
                                          ContinuousOn (fun z => long.velocity z.1 z.2)
                                              {z |
                                                0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                                            ContinuousOn (fun z => long.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                                                {z |

                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧

          (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W) (model.strain.field box m) high.strain long.strain err.strainHigh
          long.errStrain err.strain →

            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) (model.vorticityGrad.field box m) high.vorticityGrad

              (R.cellForm K - Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.energyLeafForm D R K) x ≤
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x +
                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x -
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).top x +
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x +
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowsEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            (∀ (j : Fin 9), 0 < (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) ∧
              ∀ (b : Fin 3), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑b, ⋯⟩) →

                            ∀ (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),

                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), (A.blocks K).rowWeight.PosDef) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),

declarations.name: Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData.rec
declarations.type:
{p : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialData} →
  {C : ℝ} →
    {motive : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData p C → Sort u} →
      ((theta_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => p.theta z.1 z.2) →
          (phi_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => p.phi z.1 z.2) →
            (flux_measurable : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => p.flux z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (pressure_measurable :
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => p.pressure z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                (theta_weak :
                    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
                      Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (p.theta σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                        (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.theta σ) y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                  (phi_weak :
                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
                        Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (p.phi σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                          (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.phi σ) y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                    (flux_weak :
                        ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                          Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsWeakMatrixDivergence (p.flux σ)
                            (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.matrixDivergence (p.flux σ))) →
                      (pressure_weak :
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsWeakScalarGradient (p.pressure σ)
                              (Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ))) →
                        (value_decay :
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              ‖p.theta σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                                ‖fderiv ℝ (p.theta σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3 ∧
                                  ‖p.phi σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ∧
                                    ‖fderiv ℝ (p.phi σ) y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                                      ‖p.flux σ y‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧ |p.pressure σ y| ≤ C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2) →
                          (second_decay :
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.theta σ) y)‖ ≤
                                      C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 4 ∧
                                    ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.secondDeriv (p.phi σ) y)‖ ≤
                                        C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3 ∧
                                      ‖y‖ * ‖Breakdown.AdjointDefect.matrixDivergence (p.flux σ) y‖ ≤
                                          C / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                                        ‖y‖ * ‖Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ) y‖ ≤ C ∧
                                          ‖y‖ ^ 3 * ‖Breakdown.gradientAt (p.pressure σ) y‖ ≤ C) →
                            motive ⋯) →
        (t : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.IsPotentialData p C) → motive t
