declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
        S K x →
          (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
            (∑ ι,
                  if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                    ∑ d,
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                          (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) * D.model.periodInverse)
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                  else 0) +
                ∑ ι',
                  ∑ d,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
              ∑ l,
                x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
          ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
              (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p = Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
            ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                  (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                      (D.mesh.box K).proj
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                        (fun p' =>
                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                        p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
              (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                  ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                        ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2 else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost * ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                          2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                      else 0) ≤
                    (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                    ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                          ∑ g, if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2 else 0) +
                        if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                          2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                              ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^ 2 +
                            2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) * (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                        else 0) ≤
                      (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                        (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                          (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                            ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                          ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                              ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                        ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                          ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                            ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                              ∃ g, ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧ ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤ (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                              ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                  ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    p.1 *
                                      ∑ l,
                                        ∑ c,
                                          ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                  ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                            2 ≤
                                (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                    (fun p =>
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                    (fun p =>
                                      p.1 *
                                        ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p
                                              c‖ ^
                                          2)
                                    (D.mesh.box K).rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  (A.blocks K).rowLabel i ∉ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows →
                                    ∀ (l : Fin k),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          (D.cert.actuator l) =
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K → R.pairSlackWeight K ι ≤ (R.leaves K).boxStrain ι) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        0 < (A.blocks K).errorCost ∧
                                          0 < (A.blocks K).deactCost ∧
                                            0 < (A.blocks K).longLowCost ∧
                                              0 < (A.blocks K).longHighCost ∧
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K, 0 < (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                            (A.blocks K).leakWeight ι *
                                                ((1 / (A.blocks K).errorCost +
                                                        if Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι = 0 then 0
                                                        else 1 / (A.blocks K).freqCost ι) +
                                                      ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.activeGroups (P.potential K)
                                                              ι).card /
                                                        (A.blocks K).deactCost +
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longRowTerm D R K (A.blocks K) ι +
                                                  if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows then 1 / (A.blocks K).actuatorCost
                                                  else 0) ≤
                                              1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                  2 * Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                    (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                (R.leaves K).boxCurl ι) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                (2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                        ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                          2 +
                                                      2 *
                                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K (A.blocks K)
                                                            ι *
                                                        (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 +
                                                    if ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K then
                                                      (A.blocks K).freqCost ι *
                                                        (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ι) *
                                                            (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) ^
                                                          2
                                                    else 0) ≤
                                                  (R.leaves K).boxVelocity ι) →
                                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                                  2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).velocity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ∧
                                                    2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                          ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity +
                                                              (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                            2 +
                                                        2 *
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longSourceCost D R K
                                                              (A.blocks K) ι *
                                                          (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).bandVelAllowance ι) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                    ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                      (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                          ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K α p a) ≤
                                                        (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2) →
                                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                      ∀ (σ θ : ℝ),
                                                        (Breakdown.cnormSq fun a =>
                                                            ∑ α ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g,
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.labelPhase D.azimuthOrder α σ θ *
                                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K α p a) ≤
                                                          (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                        |1 / D.cert.period q - D.model.periodInverse| ≤
                                                          (D.modelErrors K).periodInverse) →
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S

                                  -E.floor ≤ ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).grad ∧
                                    -E.floor ≤
                                      (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) *
                                        ((E.entry j).lowCoef (D.pieces q) (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn p).vel) →
                    (resolved_valid :
                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ≤
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                        (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).hess ∧
                                  (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ≤
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                          (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curlHess ∧
                                    (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ≤
                                        (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                            (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).curl ∧
                                      (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ≤
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                              (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).strain ∧
                                        (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity ≤
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients.ofPieces (D.pieces q) (D.cert.period q)
                                              (D.bounds q) D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
                      (resolved_floor :
                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K ∪ D.mesh.band K,
                              ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).hess ∧
                                  -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curlHess ∧
                                    -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).curl ∧
                                      -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).strain ∧
                                        -E.resolvedFloor ≤ (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * (E.resolvedLow (↑K) ι).velocity) →

  {box : Fin count → Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
    {m : ℕ} →
      {K : Fin count} →
        {deg : ℕ} →
          {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →

                  {high : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelHigh} →
                    {long : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelLong} →
                      {motive :
                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsCellModelSplit box m K deg W HW model err high long →
                            Sort u} →
                        ((velocity :
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K) W (model.velocity.field box m)
                                high.velocity long.velocity err.velocityHigh long.errVelocity err.velocity) →
                            (vorticity :
                                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityOf W) (model.vorticity.field box m)
                                  high.vorticity long.vorticity err.vorticityHigh long.errVorticity err.vorticity) →
                              (strain :
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
                                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W) (model.strain.field box m) high.strain
                                    long.strain err.strainHigh long.errStrain err.strain) →
                                (vorticityGrad :
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPartAE
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW)
                                      (model.vorticityGrad.field box m) high.vorticityGrad long.vorticityGrad
                                      err.vorticityGradHigh long.errVorticityGrad err.vorticityGrad) →
                                  (long_modes :
                                      ∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                                        |α.1| ≤ 2 * ↑long.cut →
                                          ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                            (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.velocity p a = 0) ∧
                                              (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.vorticity p a = 0) ∧
                                                (∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.strain p (a, b) = 0) ∧
                                                  ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.vorticityGrad p (a, b) = 0) →
                                    (long_regular :
                                        ContinuousOn (fun z => long.velocity z.1 z.2)
                                            {z |
                                              0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                                          ContinuousOn (fun z => long.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                                              {z |
                                                0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.strain z.1 z.2)
                                                MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2)
                                                MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                      (long_symmetric :
                                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (long.strain σ y) = long.strain σ y) →
                                        (long_nonneg :
                                            0 ≤ long.errVelocity ∧
                                              0 ≤ long.errVorticity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errStrain ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticityGrad) →
                                          (velocity_orthogonal :
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1)

                                            (vorticity_orthogonal :

                                                  high.vorticity) →
                                              (strain_orthogonal :
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m
                                                    (2 * deg + 1) high.strain) →
                                                (vorticityGrad_orthogonal :
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m
                                                      (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticityGrad) →
                                                  (high_symmetric :
                                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (high.strain σ y) =
                                                          high.strain σ y) →
                                                    (high_measurable :
                                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                            (fun z => high.velocity z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                              (fun z => high.vorticity z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                (fun z => high.strain z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                (fun z => high.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2)
                                                                MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                      (model_conj_closed :
                                                          model.velocity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                                            model.vorticity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                                              model.strain.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                                                model.vorticityGrad.IsConjugateClosed box) →
                                                        (errors_nonneg :
                                                            0 ≤ err.velocity ∧
                                                              0 ≤ err.vorticity ∧
                                                                0 ≤ err.strain ∧
                                                                  0 ≤ err.vorticityGrad ∧
                                                                    0 ≤ err.velocityHigh ∧
                                                                      0 ≤ err.vorticityHigh ∧
                                                                        0 ≤ err.strainHigh ∧
                                                                          0 ≤ err.vorticityGradHigh) →
                                                          motive ⋯) →
                          (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsCellModelSplit box m K deg W HW model err high long) →

        {R : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ProfileShapeEntry k} →
          {Pr : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.PressureShapeEntry k} →
            {Z : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.AdjointShapeEntry k} →
              {O : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry k} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry D R Pr Z O → Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.IsOffsetExpansionEntry D R Pr Z O) →
                    ((period_eq :
                          ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params, 1 / D.cert.period q = O.freqCentre + ∑ i, q i * O.freqTangent i) →
                        (multiplier_eq :
                            ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                              ∀ (l : Fin k), D.cert.multiplier q l = O.multCentre l + ∑ i, q i * O.multTangent i l) →
                          (centre_close :
                              ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                |O.offsetCentre j -
                                      (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multCentre l -
                                        Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                                          (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.centreCoefficient
                                            D R Pr O)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                                  O.centreErr j) →
                            (linear_close :
                                ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                    |O.offsetLinear j i -
                                          (∑ l, D.cert.frame l j * O.multTangent i l -
                                            Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                                              (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.linearCoefficient
                                                D R Pr O i)
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
                                      O.linearErr j i) →
                              (quad_close :
                                  ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                    ∀ (i l : Fin k),
                                      i ≤ l →
                                        |O.offsetQuad j i l +
                                              Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                                                (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.quadraticCoefficient
                                                  R O i l)
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j))| ≤
                                          O.quadErr j i l) →
                                (farDefect_nonneg : 0 ≤ O.farDefect) →
                                  (farAdjoint_nonneg : ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet, 0 ≤ O.farAdjoint j) →
                                    (far_defect :
                                        ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                          (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                              if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then ‖D.cert.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
                                            ENNReal.ofReal (O.farDefect ^ 2)) →
                                      (far_adjoint :
                                          ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,
                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                if R.matchRadius < ‖y‖ then
                                                  ‖Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j) σ
                                                        y‖ ^
                                                    2
                                                else 0) ≤
                                              ENNReal.ofReal (O.farAdjoint j ^ 2)) →
                                        (offset_eq :
                                            ∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,

    [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
      {T : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.SignedTree A B} →
        {ν : T.Node} →
          {D : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.RealNodeData A B} →
            {E F : Matrix (A ⊕ B) (A ⊕ B) ℝ} →
              {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesRealNodeEnclosure T ν D E F → Sort u} →
                ((input_lower :
                      ∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue D.input x ≤
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x +
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i => |x i|) →
                    (input_symm : D.input.transpose = D.input) →
                      (base_symm : D.base.transpose = D.base) →
                        (weight_pos : ∀ (j : A ⊕ B), 0 < D.weight j) →
                          (input_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ E i j) →
                            (input_error_symm : E.transpose = E) →
                              (front_error_nonneg : ∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                                (front_error_symm : F.transpose = F) →
                                  (row_bound :
                                      ∀ (i : A ⊕ B),
                                        D.weight i *
                                            ∑ j,
                                              (|Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.slackRemainder D.input D.base
                                                        (T.pivots ν) D.pivotValue D.posColumns (T.nodeColumns ν) i j| +
                                                    E i j +
                                                  F i j) /
                                                D.weight j ≤
                                          D.radius i) →
                                    (front_upper :
                                        ∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                                (D.base -
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.pivotDiagonal
                                                    (Finset.univ \ T.pivots ν) D.radius)
                                                x +
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i => |x i|) →
                                      (slack_le : ∀ j ∈ T.pivots ν, T.slack ν j ≤ D.pivotValue j - D.radius j) →
                                        motive ⋯) →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesRealNodeEnclosure T ν D E F) → motive t

∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {e : ℝ} {T : Breakdown.CertCell.TreeEntry D R}
  {W : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowEntry D R T},
  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), T.embed K = W.rowEmbed K) →
    T.keyLayout.order = D.azimuthOrder →
      (∀ (j : Fin R.creditCount) (e : Fin (R.creditPatch j).dataCount) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.headUnit D R (R.creditOwner j e) ι (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (R.creditCoord j e))) = 0) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (d : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellVar D.mesh K (R.layouts K)),
            W.Accounted K d) →
          (∀ (y : T.Slaved ⊕ T.Free → ℝ),
              y ⬝ᵥ T.globalLeaf.mulVec y ≤
                Breakdown.CertCell.globalForm D e (fun i => y (Sum.inl (W.kappa i))) fun i => y (Sum.inr (W.zeta i))) →
            T.freeMap = 0 →
              (∀ (i : Fin k), T.evalCell (W.kappa i) = none ∧ T.evalKappa (W.kappa i) = some i) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ↥(D.mesh.resolved K)),
                    (R.cellForm K).mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.headUnit D R K ↑ι) = 0 ∧
                      (R.cellForm K).conjTranspose.mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.headUnit D R K ↑ι) = 0) →
                  (∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                      (T.basePoint q).v = 0 ∧
                        (T.basePoint q).G = 0 ∧
                          (T.basePoint q).H = 0 ∧
                            (T.basePoint q).g = 0 ∧ (T.basePoint q).κ = 0 ∧ (T.basePoint q).F = 0) →
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.TreeRowConditions D R e T W

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsCrossWaveEntry.casesOn
declarations.type:
{X : Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.CrossWaveEntry} →
  {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsCrossWaveEntry X → Sort u} →
    (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsCrossWaveEntry X) →
      ((order_pos : 1 ≤ X.azimuthOrder) →
          (strainBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ X.strainBound) →
            (vorticityGradBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ X.vorticityGradBound) →
              (balance_pos : 0 < X.balance) →
                (length_pos : 0 < X.length) →
                  (strain_majorant :
                      ∀ p ∈ X.region,
                        ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                          (Breakdown.cnormSq fun i =>
                              ∑ j,
                                (∑ n ∈ X.waveModes,
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.azimuthPhase X.azimuthOrder n θ *
                                      ((X.strainMode n p (i, j) + X.strainMode n p (j, i)) / 2)) *
                                  u j) ≤
                            X.strainBound ^ 2 * Breakdown.cnormSq u) →
                    (vorticityGrad_majorant :
                        ∀ p ∈ X.region,
                          ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                            (Breakdown.cnormSq fun j =>
                                ∑ l,
                                  (∑ n ∈ X.waveModes,
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.azimuthPhase X.azimuthOrder n θ *
                                        Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (X.vorticityGradMode n p) (j, l)) *
                                    u l) ≤
                              X.vorticityGradBound ^ 2 * Breakdown.cnormSq u) →
                      motive ⋯) →

                      (test_index : ∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.testOf a < R.testCount (R.cellOf a) (R.labelOf a)) →
                        (rows_distinct :
                            ∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                              R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                                R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b →
                                  R.testOf a = R.testOf b → R.realPart a = R.realPart b → a = b) →
                          (weight_pos : ∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, 0 < R.testWeight K ι) →
                            (weight_le : ∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K ι ≤ tauMax) →
                              (weight_neg :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K (-ι) = R.testWeight K ι) →

                                    ∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                                        R.testCount K (-ι) = R.testCount K ι ∧

                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K (-ι) i c) p =
                                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K ι i c)
                                                    p)) →
                                  (rows_one_member :
                                      ∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                                        R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                                          R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf b → R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b) →
                                    (zero_label_real :
                                        ∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf a → R.realPart a = true) →

                                            ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                                              ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                                ∀ (part : Bool),

                                                        (R.labelOf a = ι ∨ R.labelOf a = -ι) ∧

            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess σ
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))

        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R Y.assembly Y.coupling.pairing

                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ↥(D.mesh.resolved K)),
                          (Y.assembly.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.headUnit D R K ↑ι) = 0) →

                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.isPressureDatum ((R.layouts K).layout ↑d.fst) d.snd = true →
                              (∀ (j : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                                  (Y.assembly.blocks K).potentialKept (Sum.inl (Sum.inl d)) j = 0 ∧

                                      ∀ (j : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                                        (Y.assembly.blocks K).topBlock ι j (Sum.inl (Sum.inl d)) = 0) ∧
                                  ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 12),
                                    (Y.assembly.blocks K).potentialSource ι (Sum.inl (Sum.inl d)) p j = 0 ∧

                    ENNReal.ofReal (N.centreGrad ^ 2)) →

                      ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.field q σ x - P.field 0 σ x) y‖ ^ 3) ≤

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.potentialExact D R K (P.potential K) x -
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.highOwnAmount D K (P.potential K) (D.mesh.resolved K)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperProfiles D R K (P.potential K) x)) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
            S K x →
              ∑ ι,
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι true /
                      (P.potential K).strainBalance ↑ι +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.couplingTailFull D R K (P.potential K) x ι false /
                      (P.potential K).velBalance ↑ι) ≤
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (P.potential K).portForm x) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, 0 < (P.potential K).strainBalance ι ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).velBalance ι) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                0 < (P.potential K).groupBalance i ∧
                  0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupStrain i ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).groupGrad i) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).length) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 < (P.potential K).epsLength) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                      (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(7 / 2) ∨ (P.potential K).groupKappa i = √(9 / 2)) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsStrain ∧ 0 ≤ (P.potential K).epsGrad) →
                      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                            (R.leaves K).strainAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).strainBalance ι +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                  (2 * (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                    3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel) ≤
                              (A.blocks K).potentialStrainCost ι) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                              (R.leaves K).velocityAbsorb ι + (P.potential K).velBalance ι +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rHatMax D K *
                                    (3 / (2 * √2) * (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain) ≤
                                (A.blocks K).potentialVelCost ι) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (α : ℤ × ℤ),
                              α ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels ↔
                                Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic D.azimuthOrder α ∈ D.givenLabels) →
                            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                    S K x →
                                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 12),
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).potentialSource ι') x p
                                            j =
                                          ∑ ι,
                                            ∑ j',
                                              (P.potential K).couplingModel (ι' - ↑ι) p j j' *
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.lowProfile D R K ι
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.upperPart D R K (P.potential K) x) p
                                                  j') →
                              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K) (j : Fin 12),
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                                        (A.blocks K).potentialSource ι d p j) →
                                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    (D.modelErrors K).strainHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highStrain ∧
                                      (D.modelErrors K).vorticityGradHigh ≤ (P.potential K).highGrad) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      0 < (P.potential K).youngCurl ∧
                                        0 < (P.potential K).youngStrain ∧ 0 < (P.potential K).youngVel) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                            (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *
                                                        (P.potential K).longStrain +
                                                    (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl +
                                                  (A.blocks K).bandCurlAllowance ι ≤
                                                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
                                              ((⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                                                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                                                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι *

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.IsPairSurrogate.rec
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {S : Fin k → Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} →
            {ePair : Fin D.mesh.count → ℝ} →
              {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.IsPairSurrogate D R S ePair → Sort u} →
                ((actuator_labels : ∀ (i : Fin k), ∀ ι ∈ S i, ι ∈ R.pairLabels ∧ -ι ∈ R.pairLabels) →
                    (pin_labels :
                        ∀ (i : Fin k) (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                          ∀ ι ∈ (D.pinValues i).labels K, ι ∈ R.pairLabels ∧ -ι ∈ R.pairLabels) →
                      (pin_profile :
                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                            ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                              ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                R.pairProfile K (Sum.inr i) ι p a b =
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.pin i) a b p) →
                        (exact_off_slack :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k),
                              ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                                ι ∉ R.pairSlackLabels K →
                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                      R.pairProfile K (Sum.inl i) ι p a b =
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι
                                          (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i)) a b p) →
                          (profile_regular :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin k ⊕ Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (a b : Fin 3),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b)
                                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                  ∃ c, ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect, ‖R.pairProfile K g ι p a b‖ ≤ c) →
                            (slack_in_labels : ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), R.pairSlackLabels K ⊆ R.pairLabels) →
                              (slack_weight_pos :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), ∀ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K, 0 < R.pairSlackWeight K ι) →
                                (surrogate_error :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∑ ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K,
                                          (4 * R.pairSlackWeight K ι)⁻¹ *
                                            ∑ i,
                                              ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                p.1 *
                                                  ∑ a,
                                                    ∑ b,
                                                      ‖R.pairProfile K (Sum.inl i) ι p a b -
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                              (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i)) a b p‖ ^
                                                        2 ≤
                                        ePair K) →
                                  motive ⋯) →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.IsPairSurrogate D R S ePair) → motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
          S K x →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
              ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                S K x →
                  ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                          (fun a b =>
                            1 / 2 *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                          0) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
              ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                  ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                    S K x →
                      ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p = 0) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                  ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                    (∃ g a b,
                        ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect] 0) →
                      ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                        0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                          (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                            ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                              (∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef fun p =>
                                      ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                    ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                      ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                        (∃ g a b,
                            ¬(fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                0) →
                          ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                            ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                        p.1 *
                                          ∑ a,
                                            ∑ b,
                                              ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a
                                                    b‖ ^
                                                2 ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                    ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                      0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                        ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                          0 ≤ Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι) →
                    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι) →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S

  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},

              (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
            ((⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) +

                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) *

                (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
              (⨆ j, (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑j, ⋯⟩) +
                    3 / (2 * √2) *
                      (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                          (P.potential K).length +

declarations.name: Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k} →
    {j : Fin k} →
      {r : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectEntry k} →
        {motive : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded d j r → Sort u} →
          (t : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded d j r) →
            ((coordBound_adjoint : ∀ i ∈ d.adjointSet, d.radius i ≤ r.coordBound i) →
                (coordBound_stiff :
                    ∀ i ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ, d.scale i ≠ 0 ∧ |d.stiffRadius| ≤ |d.scale i| * r.coordBound i) →
                  (centre_norms : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms r.centrePotential r.centreNumbers) →
                    (centre_remainder :
                        ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                          Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                            (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.centreResidual q) r.pinFlux
                              r.centrePotential)
                            r.centreNumbers.remainder) →
                      (fitted_norms :
                          ∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet,
                            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms (r.fittedPotential i) (r.fittedNumbers i)) →
                        (fitted_remainder :
                            ∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet,
                              Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.fittedResidual i) (fun x x_1 => 0)
                                  (r.fittedPotential i))
                                (r.fittedNumbers i).remainder) →
                          (freeWeight_pos : ∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, 0 < r.freeWeight i) →
                            (freeValue_nonneg : 0 ≤ r.freeValue) →
                              (freeDual_nonneg : 0 ≤ r.freeDual) →
                                (free_value :
                                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                      (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                          (∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * ‖r.free q i σ y‖ ^ 2) *
                                            ‖r.field σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                        ENNReal.ofReal (r.freeValue ^ 2)) →
                                  (free_dual :
                                      ∃ δ,
                                        (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ,
                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                              Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                                (fun σ y =>
                                                  Breakdown.AdjointDefect.transposeApply (fderiv ℝ (r.free q i σ) y)
                                                    (r.field σ y))
                                                (δ i)) ∧
                                          ∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * δ i ^ 2 ≤ r.freeDual ^ 2) →
                                    (time_dual :
                                        Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                          (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative r.field) r.timeDual) →
                                      (pinError_nonneg : 0 ≤ r.pinError) →
                                        (pinRound_nonneg : 0 ≤ r.pinRound) →
                                          (pin_error :
                                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                  ‖∑ l,
                                                        r.pinCoef l •
                                                          (r.pins.potential l σ y - r.pins.generator l σ y)‖ ^
                                                    2) ≤
                                                ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinError ^ 2)) →
                                            (pin_round :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                      Breakdown.matSq
                                                        (∑ l,
                                                          c l • (d.pin l σ y - fderiv ℝ (r.pins.potential l σ) y))) ≤
                                                    ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinRound ^ 2 * ∑ l, c l ^ 2)) →
                                              (pinCoef_norm : √(∑ l, r.pinCoef l ^ 2) ≤ r.pinCoefNorm) →
                                                (total :
                                                    r.defectSum d.weight + r.pinCharge d.weight ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                  motive ⋯) →
              motive t

  {resolved : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)} →
    {coef : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ × ℝ → Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCoefficients} →
      {ch : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges} →
        {T : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.LeafValues} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T → Sort u} →
            ((hessFloor_pos : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 < T.hessFloor ι) →
                (hessFloor_le : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.hessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).hess) →
                  (curlHessFloor_nonneg : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, 0 ≤ T.curlHessFloor ι) →
                    (curlHessFloor_le : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, T.curlHessFloor ι ≤ (coef ι p).curlHess) →
                      (matrix_hermitian : ∀ ι ∈ resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, (T.localMatrix ι p).IsHermitian) →
                        (matrix_regular :
                            ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                              (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => T.localMatrix ι p i j) ∧
                                ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖T.localMatrix ι p i j‖ ≤ C) →
                          (matrix_le :
                              ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                  ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.coefPairValue (coef ι p) s v -
                                        T.boxPenalty ι s v) →
                            (pointwise :
                                ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                    p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                      ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                        0 ≤
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (T.localMatrix ι p)
                                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) -
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss (ch.curl ι p)
                                                    (ch.product ι p) (ch.gradient ι p) (ch.length ι p) s v -
                                                T.boxPairPenalty ι s v) +
                                            T.absorbValue ι s v) →
                              (charges_nonneg :
                                  ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p ∧ 0 < ch.length ι p) →
                                (symmetric :
                                    ∀ ι ∈ resolved,
                                      T.hessFloor (-ι) = T.hessFloor ι ∧
                                        T.curlHessFloor (-ι) = T.curlHessFloor ι ∧
                                          T.curlAbsorb (-ι) = T.curlAbsorb ι ∧
                                            T.strainAbsorb (-ι) = T.strainAbsorb ι ∧
                                              T.velocityAbsorb (-ι) = T.velocityAbsorb ι) →
                                  motive ⋯) →
              (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsLeafValues K resolved coef ch T) → motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsRegionChargeBound.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {Z : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {ch : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges},
  (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
      ∀ p ∈ Z,
        ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
          inner ℝ
              ((Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W σ (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
              u ≤
            ch.curl ι p * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
        ∀ p ∈ Z,
          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.opBound
            (fun a b =>
              Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m (0, 0) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) p (a, b))
            (ch.product ι p)) →
      (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
          ∀ p ∈ Z,
            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW σ
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                      u -
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellMatField.frameMap θ fun a b =>
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m (0, 0) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) p
                            (a, b)).re)
                      u‖ ≤
                ch.gradient ι p * ‖u‖) →
        (∀ (ι ι' : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ p ∈ Z, ch.length ι p = ch.length ι' p) →
          (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ p ∈ Z, 0 < ch.length ι p) →
            (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ p ∈ Z, 0 ≤ ch.product ι p ∧ 0 ≤ ch.gradient ι p) →
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsRegionChargeBound m Z W HW ch

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh →
    (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
        S K x →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue
              (R.cellForm K - Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.energyLeafForm D R K) x ≤
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).potentialKept x +
                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x -
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).top x +
                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x +
              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowsEliminated D K (A.blocks K) x) →
      (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
          ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
            (∀ (j : Fin 9), 0 < (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) ∧
              ∀ (b : Fin 3), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandWeight ι ⟨9 + ↑b, ⋯⟩) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
              Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ι ≠ 0 ∧
                Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ι ^ 2 ≠ 1) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).bandSlack ∧ (A.blocks K).bandSlack < 1) →
            (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                (A.blocks K).bandSlack = 0 →
                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                    ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                      S K x →
                        ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (j : Fin 9),
                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.turnedSource D (A.blocks K) ι x p j =
                            ↑((A.blocks K).bandWeight ι (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).bandMap ι) x p
                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.gradSlot j)) →
              (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                    ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                      (∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                          Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                            (A.blocks K).potentialSource ι d p j) ∧
                        (∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p =>
                              (A.blocks K).pairingSource ι d p j) ∧
                          (∀ (d : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p => (A.blocks K).bandMap ι d p j) ∧
                            ∀ (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.IsBoundedOnCell D K fun p => (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι p j) →
                (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count), (A.blocks K).rowWeight.PosDef) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                      ((A.blocks K).rowFull - (A.blocks K).rowWeight -
                          (1 - ↑(A.blocks K).bandSlack)⁻¹ •
                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.bandGram D K (A.blocks K)).PosSemidef) →
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.EliminationConditions D R A S

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k} {j : Fin k} {r : Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectEntry k},
  (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSet, d.radius i ≤ r.coordBound i) →
    (∀ i ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ, d.scale i ≠ 0 ∧ |d.stiffRadius| ≤ |d.scale i| * r.coordBound i) →
      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms r.centrePotential r.centreNumbers →
        (∀ q ∈ d.params,
            Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
              (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.centreResidual q) r.pinFlux r.centrePotential)
              r.centreNumbers.remainder) →
          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet, Breakdown.AdjointDefect.PotentialNorms (r.fittedPotential i) (r.fittedNumbers i)) →
            (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSet,
                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                  (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.remainderField d.weight (r.fittedResidual i) (fun x x_1 => 0)
                    (r.fittedPotential i))
                  (r.fittedNumbers i).remainder) →
              (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, 0 < r.freeWeight i) →
                0 ≤ r.freeValue →
                  0 ≤ r.freeDual →
                    (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                            (∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * ‖r.free q i σ y‖ ^ 2) * ‖r.field σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                          ENNReal.ofReal (r.freeValue ^ 2)) →
                      (∃ δ,
                          (∀ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ,
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded
                                  (fun σ y =>
                                    Breakdown.AdjointDefect.transposeApply (fderiv ℝ (r.free q i σ) y) (r.field σ y))
                                  (δ i)) ∧
                            ∑ i ∈ r.fittedSetᶜ, r.freeWeight i * δ i ^ 2 ≤ r.freeDual ^ 2) →
                        Breakdown.AdjointDefect.DualBounded (Breakdown.AdjointDefect.timeDerivative r.field)
                            r.timeDual →
                          0 ≤ r.pinError →
                            0 ≤ r.pinRound →
                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                    ‖∑ l, r.pinCoef l • (r.pins.potential l σ y - r.pins.generator l σ y)‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                  ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinError ^ 2) →
                                (∀ (c : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                        Breakdown.matSq
                                          (∑ l, c l • (d.pin l σ y - fderiv ℝ (r.pins.potential l σ) y))) ≤
                                      ENNReal.ofReal (r.pinRound ^ 2 * ∑ l, c l ^ 2)) →
                                  √(∑ l, r.pinCoef l ^ 2) ≤ r.pinCoefNorm →
                                    r.defectSum d.weight + r.pinCharge d.weight ≤ d.adjointDefect j →
                                      Breakdown.AdjointDefect.AdjointDefectBounded d j r

  {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => v z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => G z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => H z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => g z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic v →
            Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic G →
              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic H →
                Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic g →
                  (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (v σ) (G σ)) →
                    (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ),
                        ∀ (j : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                            (H σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                      (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ((G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)).ofLp i = 0) →
                        (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖v σ y‖ ^ 6) < ⊤) →

                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H σ y)‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →

                                (∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                    Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestVector φ →
                                      ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),

                                              (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) =
                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (g z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2)) →
                                  (∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), v (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) = γ.1 (v z.1 z.2)) →
