declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions.recOn
declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {C : Type} →
    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S → Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.RowFunctionalConditions D R A P S) →
                    ((cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                        (row_map :
                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount)
                              (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                              S K x →
                                (A.blocks K).rowMap.mulVec x i =
                                  (∑ ι,
                                        if ↑ι = (A.blocks K).rowLabel i then
                                          ∑ d,
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι)
                                                (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder ↑ι))
                                                (2 * Real.pi * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTime ↑ι) *
                                                  D.model.periodInverse)
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι x d
                                        else 0) +
                                      ∑ ι',
                                        ∑ d,
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.couplingRowVector ((R.layouts K).layout ↑ι')
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVelocity D K
                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelVorticity D K
                                                ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i - ↑ι'))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) d *
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.restrictData D R K ι' x d +
                                    ∑ l,
                                      x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl l)) *
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.actuatorRow D K ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)
                                          (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i)
                                          ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l)) →
                          (row_band :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                  ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                    (A.blocks K).rowBand i ι' p =
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p) →
                            (row_tail :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                  ∀ ι' ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                      ∀ (j : Fin 12),
                                        (A.blocks K).rowTailTest i ι' p j =
                                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p j -
                                            (D.mesh.box K).proj
                                              (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                              else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                              (if ↑j < 9 then ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef
                                              else ((R.layouts K).layout ι').degCoef - 1)
                                              (fun p' =>
                                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat (D.mesh.box K) p') *
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowCrossTest D K (A.blocks K) i ι' p' j)
                                              p) →
                              (partners_leak :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin (P.potential K).groupCount),
                                    (P.potential K).rowPartners g ⊆ (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                (leak_curl :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                        ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                              ∑ g,
                                                if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then (P.potential K).groupVel g ^ 2
                                                else 0) +
                                            if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                              2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                  ((D.modelErrors K).velocity + (D.modelErrors K).velocityHigh) ^ 2 +
                                                2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                  (R.long K).errVelocity ^ 2
                                            else 0) ≤
                                          (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι) →
                                  (leak_vel :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes,
                                          ((2 * (A.blocks K).deactCost *
                                                ∑ g,
                                                  if ι ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g then
                                                    (P.potential K).groupCurl g ^ 2
                                                  else 0) +
                                              if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.tested K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                                                2 * (A.blocks K).errorCost *
                                                    ((D.modelErrors K).vorticity + (D.modelErrors K).vorticityHigh) ^
                                                      2 +
                                                  2 * ((A.blocks K).longLowCost + (A.blocks K).longHighCost) *
                                                    (R.long K).errVorticity ^ 2
                                              else 0) ≤
                                            (A.blocks K).leakVel ι) →
                                    (tests_valid :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin (A.blocks K).rowCount),
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal (D.mesh.box K)
                                              (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                  ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                              (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest (D.mesh.box K)
                                                (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth D.azimuthOrder
                                                    ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)))
                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestOfShape (D.mesh.box K)
                                                  ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide
                                                  (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.rowTestPoly D K (A.blocks K) i) ∧
                                                ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degSide + 2 ≤
                                                    ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i)).degCoef ∧
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPressureSegmentation
                                                    ((R.layouts K).layout ((A.blocks K).rowLabel i))) →
                                      (rows_groups_cover :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                            ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                              ∀ ι' ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                                ι' ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                                  ι - ι' ∈ Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.modelLabels D K →
                                                    ∃ g,
                                                      ι' ∈ (P.potential K).rowPartners g ∧
                                                        ι - ι' ∈ (P.potential K).groupHarmonics g) →
                                        (sources_leak :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.deactSources D K (P.potential K) ⊆
                                                (A.blocks K).leakModes) →
                                          (actuator_pos :
                                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                0 < (A.blocks K).actuatorCost ∧ 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                            (actuator_kappa :
                                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                  (A.blocks K).actuatorCost * (A.blocks K).actuatorErr ≤
                                                    (A.blocks K).rowKappaCost) →
                                              (actuator_err :
                                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                                    ∑ ι ∈ (A.blocks K).actuatorRows,
                                                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                          p.1 *
                                                            ∑ l,
                                                              ∑ c,
                                                                ‖Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                        (D.cert.actuator l) p c -
                                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                                        ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel ↑l) p c‖ ^
                                                                  2 ≤
                                                      (A.blocks K).actuatorErr) →
                                                (actuator_model_regular :
                                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (l : ℕ) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (c : Fin 3),
                                                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                          (fun p =>
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel D.azimuthOrder ι
                                                              ((A.blocks K).actuatorModel l) p c)
                                                          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                                                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn

declarations.type:
{C : Type} →
  {nE nM : ℕ} →
    {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} →
      {P : ℝ} →
        {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds} →
          {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
              {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ} →
                {motive :
                    Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                      Sort u} →
                  ((ampW_ge :
                        ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                      (ampGradW_ge :
                          ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                h.ampGradW β y) →
                        (ampVort_ge :
                            ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                      (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                  h.ampVort β y) →
                          (ampGradVort_ge :
                              ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                        (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                    h.ampGradVort β y) →
                            (supVort_ge :
                                ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                              (supGradVort_ge :
                                  ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                      h.supGradVort y) →
                                (epsSpeed_ge :
                                    ∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                            (m.epsP β).frame •
                                              (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                        (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                  (muSpeed_ge :
                                      ∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                              (m.muP β).frame •
                                                (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                  (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                          (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                    (eps_oneSided :
                                        ∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                          ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                            ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                              Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                      (mu_oneSided :
                                          ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                            ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                              ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                        (mu_ratio :
                                            ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                              (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                  2 ≤
                                                ratio *
                                                  ∑ β,
                                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                        |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                      (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                          (ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ ratio) →
                                            (eps_sum_le : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                              (eps_grad_sum_le :
                                                  ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                                (conv_le :
                                                    ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                  motive ⋯) →
                    (t :
                        Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup
                          ratio) →
                      motive t

declarations.type:

  {Tb : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.FarFieldValueSets},

        ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
          inner ℝ
              ((Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf D.given σ (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                u)
              u ≤
            Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.strain
                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) *
              ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
      (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.opBound
            (fun a b =>
              Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)
                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess) p (a, b))
            (Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p))) →
        (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
            ∀ (σ θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
              ‖(Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess σ
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                      u -
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellMatField.frameMap θ fun a b =>
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad D.azimuthOrder (0, 0)
                            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf D.givenHess) p (a, b)).re)

                Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) *
                  ‖u‖) →
          (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
              ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                (D.charges none).curl ι p =
                    Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.strain
                      (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                  (D.charges none).product ι p =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧
                    (D.charges none).gradient ι p =
                      Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.waveGrad
                        (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →
            (∀ (ι ι' : ℤ × ℤ),
                ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                  (D.charges none).length ι p = (D.charges none).length ι' p) →
              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane, 0 < (D.charges none).length ι p) →
                (∀ p ∈ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane,
                    0 ≤
                        Breakdown.CertCell.ScalarShape.ChartBound.eval Tb.chart Tb.meanGrad
                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p) ∧

                          (Breakdown.CertCell.planePoint p)) →

      0 < bc.secondLength ∧ 0 ≤ bc.strainSlack ∧ 0 < bc.orthWeight ∧ ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ bc.rowWeight ι) →

                              ∀ (s : Fin R.segmentCount), Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsPlaneSegment (R.segment s)) →
                            (segments_cover :
                                ∀ (r : ℝ),
                                  R.inner ≤ r → r ≤ R.outer → ∃ s, (R.segment s).lower ≤ r ∧ r ≤ (R.segment s).upper) →
                              (segments_disjoint :
                                  ∀ (s s' : Fin R.segmentCount),
                                    s ≠ s' →
                                      (R.segment s).upper ≤ (R.segment s').lower ∨
                                        (R.segment s').upper ≤ (R.segment s).lower) →
                                (segments_inside :
                                    ∀ (s : Fin R.segmentCount),
                                      R.inner ≤ (R.segment s).lower ∧ (R.segment s).upper ≤ R.outer) →
                                  (trace_expansion :
                                      ∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (s : Fin R.segmentCount) (r : ℝ),
                                        (R.segment s).lower ≤ r →
                                          r ≤ (R.segment s).upper →
                                            r * R.test i (r, 0) =
                                              ∑ d,
                                                if (R.dataOf d).fst = s then
                                                  R.traceMap i d * (R.segment (R.dataOf d).fst).test (R.dataOf d).snd r
                                                else 0) →
                                    (form_posDef : R.testForm.PosDef) →
                                      (form_bound :
                                          ∀ (c : Fin R.testCount → ℂ),
                                            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.patch R.inner R.outer R.height,
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.patchGradSq R.label.2 (R.testCombination c)
                                                      p /
                                                    R.charge p *
                                                  p.1 ≤
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.realQuadForm R.testForm c) →
                                        (credit_le :
                                            ∀ (g : Fin R.dataCount → ℂ),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm R.credit g ≤
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.realQuadForm R.testForm⁻¹ (R.traceData g)) →
                                          motive ⋯) →
        motive t

declarations.type:
∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] {T : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.SignedTree A B} {ν : T.Node}
  {D : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.RealNodeData A B} {E F : Matrix (A ⊕ B) (A ⊕ B) ℝ},
  (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue D.input x ≤
        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.nodeInput ν) x + Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue E fun i => |x i|) →
    D.input.transpose = D.input →
      D.base.transpose = D.base →
        (∀ (j : A ⊕ B), 0 < D.weight j) →
          (∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ E i j) →
            E.transpose = E →
              (∀ (i j : A ⊕ B), 0 ≤ F i j) →
                F.transpose = F →
                  (∀ (i : A ⊕ B),
                      D.weight i *
                          ∑ j,
                            (|Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.slackRemainder D.input D.base (T.pivots ν) D.pivotValue
                                      D.posColumns (T.nodeColumns ν) i j| +
                                  E i j +
                                F i j) /
                              D.weight j ≤
                        D.radius i) →
                    (∀ (x : A ⊕ B → ℝ),
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (T.front ν) x ≤
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                              (D.base -
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.pivotDiagonal (Finset.univ \ T.pivots ν) D.radius)
                              x +
                            Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue F fun i => |x i|) →
                      (∀ j ∈ T.pivots ν, T.slack ν j ≤ D.pivotValue j - D.radius j) →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.PassesRealNodeEnclosure T ν D E F

            (D.charges none) D.azimuthOrder (X.pointConditions j)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin X.rayCount), (X.rayConditions i).charges = X.charges) →
        (∀ (j : Fin X.pointCount), (X.pointConditions j).charges = X.charges) →
          (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, ι ∈ X.modes a) →
            X.charges.Covers (D.charges none) Set.univ (D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane) →
              (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ X.charges.curlCharge p ∧ 0 ≤ X.charges.gradCharge p ∧ 0 ≤ X.charges.velCharge p) →
                (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane ⊆ ⋃ a ∈ X.parts ι, X.region a) →
                  (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),

                    (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ), ∀ a ∈ X.parts ι, X.region a ⊆ D.mesh.exterior ∩ Breakdown.CertCell.halfPlane) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin X.rayCount ⊕ Fin X.pointCount), MeasurableSet (X.region a)) →

declarations.type:
{k : ℕ} →

    {nE nM : ℕ} →
      {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM} →
        {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} →
          {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R} →
            {Q : Fin D.mesh.count → Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingData k} →
              {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop} →
                {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S → Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PairingConditions D R A Q S) →
                    ((mesh_valid : Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh D.mesh) →
                        (cell_conditions : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusConditions D R) →
                          (kept_le :
                              ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                S K x →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
                            (source_eq :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                      S K x →
                                        ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                          ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec
                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  1 / 2 *
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                                                0) →
                              (source_zero :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                      ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                                        ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                          S K x →
                                            ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x
                                                  p =
                                                0) →
                                (gamma_resolved :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                          (∃ g a b,
                                              ¬(fun p =>
                                                    R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                      b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                  0) →
                                            ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                    (∑ a,
                                                        ∑ b,
                                                          (D.mesh.box K).tailNormSq ((R.layouts K).layout ι).degCoef
                                                            fun p =>
                                                            ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat
                                                                  (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                        ↑(w g)) →
                                  (gamma_other :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                                          ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                                            ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
                                              (∃ g a b,
                                                  ¬(fun p =>
                                                        R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                          b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                      0) →
                                                ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                                  ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes ∧
                                                    0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                                      (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧
                                                        ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,
                                                              p.1 *
                                                                ∑ a,
                                                                  ∑ b,
                                                                    ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                          (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b‖ ^
                                                                      2 ≤
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι)
                                                              fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                                    (gamma_gram :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                                            0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                              ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                0 ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                    ↑(w g)) →
                                      (leak_nonneg :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ), 0 ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι) →
                                        (cost_nonneg :
                                            ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                              0 ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι) →
                                          motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

            ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
              R.pairProfile K (Sum.inr i) ι p a b =
                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (D.cert.pin i) a b p) →
        (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (i : Fin k),
            ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,

                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i))
                        a b p) →
          (∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count) (g : Fin k ⊕ Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (a b : Fin 3),
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => R.pairProfile K g ι p a b)
                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) ∧
                ∃ c, ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect, ‖R.pairProfile K g ι p a b‖ ≤ c) →

                          ∑ i,

                                ∑ a,

                                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι
                                            (Breakdown.gradField (D.cert.actuator i)) a b p‖ ^

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsCellModelSplit.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {count : ℕ} {box : Fin count → Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} {m : ℕ} {K : Fin count} {deg : ℕ}
  {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {model : Breakdown.CertCell.ModelPolys count} {err : Breakdown.CertCell.ModelErrors}
  {high : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelHigh} {long : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellModelLong},
  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K) W
      (model.velocity.field box m) high.velocity long.velocity err.velocityHigh long.errVelocity err.velocity →
    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
        (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityOf W) (model.vorticity.field box m) high.vorticity long.vorticity
        err.vorticityHigh long.errVorticity err.vorticity →
      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPart (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
          (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.strainOf W) (model.strain.field box m) high.strain long.strain err.strainHigh
          long.errStrain err.strain →
        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsSplitPartAE (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.ownSolid box K)
            (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityGradOf HW) (model.vorticityGrad.field box m) high.vorticityGrad
            long.vorticityGrad err.vorticityGradHigh long.errVorticityGrad err.vorticityGrad →
          (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ),
              |α.1| ≤ 2 * ↑long.cut →
                ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                  (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.velocity p a = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (a : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α long.vorticity p a = 0) ∧
                      (∀ (a b : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.strain p (a, b) = 0) ∧
                        ∀ (a b : Fin 3), Breakdown.CertCell.labelGrad m α long.vorticityGrad p (a, b) = 0) →
            ContinuousOn (fun z => long.velocity z.1 z.2)
                  {z |
                    0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                ContinuousOn (fun z => long.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                    {z |
                      0 < Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylRadius z.2 ∧
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight z.2 ≠ 0} ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.strain z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => long.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
              (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (long.strain σ y) = long.strain σ y) →
                0 ≤ long.errVelocity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticity ∧ 0 ≤ long.errStrain ∧ 0 ≤ long.errVorticityGrad →
                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.velocity →
                    Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsVecOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticity →
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.strain →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsMatOrthogonal (box K) m (2 * deg + 1) high.vorticityGrad →
                          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (high.strain σ y) = high.strain σ y) →
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.velocity z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.vorticity z.1 z.2)
                                    MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.strain z.1 z.2)
                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => high.vorticityGrad z.1 z.2)
                                      MeasureTheory.volume →
                              model.velocity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                  model.vorticity.IsConjugateClosed box ∧
                                    model.strain.IsConjugateClosed box ∧ model.vorticityGrad.IsConjugateClosed box →
                                0 ≤ err.velocity ∧
                                    0 ≤ err.vorticity ∧
                                      0 ≤ err.strain ∧
                                        0 ≤ err.vorticityGrad ∧
                                          0 ≤ err.velocityHigh ∧
                                            0 ≤ err.vorticityHigh ∧ 0 ≤ err.strainHigh ∧ 0 ≤ err.vorticityGradHigh →

            (scale_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.scale j ≠ 0) →
              (weight_le_weightMax : d.weight ≤ d.weightMax) →
                (multiplierWeight_pos : 0 < d.multiplierWeight) →
                  (coerciveL2_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.coerciveL2) →
                    (coercivePin_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.coercivePin) →
                      (rowBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.rowBound) →
                        (gapSize_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.gapSize) →
                          (formShift_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formShift) →
                            (transfer_lt : d.transferLoss < 1) →
                              (coerciveTotal_ge : d.coerciveL2 + d.rowBound ≤ (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.coerciveTotal) →
                                (coerciveTotal_pos : 0 < d.coerciveTotal) →
                                  (actuatorBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.actuatorBound) →
                                    (modelFormBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.modelFormBound) →
                                      (formBound_ge : d.modelFormBound + d.formShift ≤ d.formBound) →
                                        (sizeBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.sizeBound) →
                                          (supBound_pos : 0 < d.supBound) →
                                            (period_le : ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.period q ≤ d.periodMax) →
                                              (twist_pos : 0 < d.twist) →
                                                (twist_mem :
                                                    d.twist = 1 ∨ d.twist = 2 ∧ ∃ Q, (Q, 1 / 2) ∈ d.symmetries) →
                                                  (actuator_norm :
                                                      (∑ i,
                                                          Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖d.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                        ENNReal.ofReal (d.actuatorBound ^ 2)) →
                                                    (defect_nonneg :
                                                        ∀ q ∈ d.params, 0 ≤ d.defectBound q ∧ 0 ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                      (defect_l2 :
                                                          ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                            (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                                ‖d.defect q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                              ENNReal.ofReal (d.defectBound q ^ 2)) →
                                                        (defect_rows :
                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.rows (d.defect q) ≤ d.defectRowBound q) →
                                                          (defect_le : ∀ q ∈ d.params, d.defectBound q ≤ d.defectMax) →
                                                            (size :
                                                                ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                  d.coerciveL2 * d.defectBound q + d.defectRowBound q +
                                                                      d.coercivePin *
                                                                        Breakdown.vecNorm (d.targetGap q) ≤
                                                                    (1 - d.transferLoss) * d.sizeBound) →
                                                              (small_first :
                                                                  2 * d.coerciveTotal *
                                                                        Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                      d.supBound <
                                                                    1) →
                                                                (small_second :
                                                                    4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 *
                                                                        (1 / d.weight +
                                                                              2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                d.formBound +
                                                                            2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                              (d.actuatorBound / d.multiplierWeight) +
                                                                          2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) /
                                                                            d.coerciveTotal) ≤
                                                                      d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                  (small_third :
                                                                      4 *
                                                                              (1 / d.weight +
                                                                                2 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) *
                                                                                  d.formBound) *
                                                                            d.sizeBound ^ 2 +
                                                                          4 * (d.periodMax / ↑d.twist) * d.sizeBound *
                                                                            (d.defectMax +
                                                                                2 * Breakdown.supBoundFactor d.weight *
                                                                                    d.sizeBound *
                                                                                  d.supBound +
                                                                              2 *
                                                                                  (d.actuatorBound /
                                                                                    d.multiplierWeight) *
                                                                                d.sizeBound) ≤
                                                                        d.supBound ^ 2) →
                                                                    (frame_unit : IsUnit d.frame) →
                                                                      (adjoint_l2 :
                                                                          ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                              ∀ (σ : ℝ),
                                                                                ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                    ENNReal.ofReal
                                                                                      (‖d.adjoint j q σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                                  ENNReal.ofReal (d.adjointL2 j ^ 2)) →
                                                                        (adjointL2_nonneg :
                                                                            ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, 0 ≤ d.adjointL2 j) →
                                                                          (adjointDefect_nonneg :
                                                                              ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                0 ≤ d.adjointDefect j) →
                                                                            (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                                ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                  0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j) →
                                                                              (adjoint_inclusion :
                                                                                  ∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                                                                                    ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                      d.adjointQuad j *
                                                                                              (2 * d.sizeBound) ^ 2 +
                                                                                            2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                              √(d.adjointDefect j ^ 2 +
                                                                                                  (Breakdown.vecNorm
                                                                                                        (d.actuatorAdjointError
                                                                                                          q j) /
                                                                                                      d.multiplierWeight) ^
                                                                                                    2) +
                                                                                          d.adjointOffset j ≤
                                                                                        |d.scale j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                                (stiffNorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.stiffNorm) →
                                                                                  (stiff_norm :
                                                                                      ∀ (x : Fin k → ℝ),
                                                                                        ∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                            (∑ i, d.frame i j * x i) ^
                                                                                              2 ≤
                                                                                          d.stiffNorm ^ 2 *
                                                                                            ∑ i, x i ^ 2) →
                                                                                    (stiff_offset :
                                                                                        ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                          √(∑ j ∈ d.adjointSetᶜ,
                                                                                                (∑ i,
                                                                                                      d.frame i j *
                                                                                                        d.multiplier q
                                                                                                          i -
                                                                                                    d.scale j * q j) ^
                                                                                                  2) ≤
                                                                                            d.stiffOffset) →
                                                                                      (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                                          2 * d.sizeBound *
                                                                                                  d.stiffNorm /
                                                                                                d.multiplierWeight +
                                                                                              d.stiffOffset ≤
                                                                                            d.stiffRadius) →
                                                                                        (nontrivial :
                                                                                            ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                                                                              4 * d.sizeBound ^ 2 /
                                                                                                  d.weight <
                                                                                                (Breakdown.periodLIntegral
                                                                                                    fun σ y =>
                                                                                                    ⋯).toReal) →

                          ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,

                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq

                                      h.ampGradVort β y) →
                              (supVort_ge :
                                  ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →

                                                  (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤

                                                (m.muP β).frame •
                                                  (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +

                                                    2 ≤

                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM}
  {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D} {A : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.AssemblyEntry D R}
  {P : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CouplingEntries D R}
  {S : (K : Fin D.mesh.count) → (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ) → Prop},
  Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.PotentialConditions D R A P S →
    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
      ∀ ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K,
        ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →
          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect,
            (((∑ i,
                      if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                        (P.potential K).groupStrain i / (P.potential K).groupBalance i
                      else 0) +
                    if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakCurl ι else 0) +
                  if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                    (P.potential K).epsStrain +
                        Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longStrain +
                      (P.potential K).highStrain / (P.potential K).youngCurl
                  else 0) ≤
                (R.entryCharges K ι).curlCharge p ∧
              ((((∑ i,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                            (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                              (P.potential K).groupBalance i
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι else 0) +
                      if ι ∈ R.pairSlackLabels K then R.pairSlackWeight K ι else 0) +
                    if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                      3 / (2 * √2) *
                        (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) *
                            (P.potential K).epsLength +
                          (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngVel)
                    else 0) ≤
                  (R.entryCharges K ι).gradCharge p ∧
                (((∑ i,
                          if ι ∈ (P.potential K).groupPartners i then
                            (P.potential K).groupKappa i / 2 * (P.potential K).groupGrad i /
                              ((P.potential K).length * (P.potential K).groupBalance i)
                          else 0) +
                        if ι ∈ (A.blocks K).leakModes then (A.blocks K).leakVel ι else 0) +
                      if ∃ ι₀ ∈ D.mesh.resolved K, ι₀ - ι ∈ (P.potential K).harmonicLabels then
                        3 / (2 * √2) *
                          (((P.potential K).epsGrad +
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.longFactor (P.potential K) ι * (P.potential K).longGrad) /
                              (P.potential K).length +
                            (P.potential K).highGrad / (P.potential K).youngStrain)
                      else 0) +
                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.creditVelDemand D R K ι p ≤
                  (R.entryCharges K ι).velCharge p

declarations.name: Breakdown.IsPerturbation.casesOn
declarations.type:
{Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry} →
  {P : ℝ} →
    {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
      {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
        {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
          {g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {motive : Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g) →
                ((measurable_velocity : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => v z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                    (measurable_gradient :
                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => G z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                      (measurable_secondDeriv :
                          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => H z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                        (measurable_derivative :
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => g z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                          (periodic_velocity : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic v) →
                            (periodic_gradient : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic G) →
                              (periodic_secondDeriv : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic H) →
                                (periodic_derivative : Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic g) →
                                  (weak_gradient : ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (v σ) (G σ)) →
                                    (weak_secondDeriv :
                                        ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ),
                                          ∀ (j : Fin 3),
                                            Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector j))
                                              fun y => (H σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                                      (divergence_free :
                                          ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            ∑ i, ((G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)).ofLp i = 0) →
                                        (sixth_power :
                                            ∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖v σ y‖ ^ 6) < ⊤) →
                                          (gradient_finite :
                                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => Breakdown.matSq (G σ y)) < ⊤) →
                                            (sumSecondPartials_finite :
                                                (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y =>
                                                    ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H σ y)‖ ^ 2) <
                                                  ⊤) →
                                              (derivative_finite :
                                                  (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖g σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                                                (transport :
                                                    ∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                                      Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestVector φ →
                                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                            inner ℝ (v z.1 z.2)
                                                              (-(1 / P) • deriv (fun s => φ s z.2) z.1 - φ z.1 z.2 -
                                                                (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) =
                                                          ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                            inner ℝ (g z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2)) →
                                                  (invariant :
                                                      ∀ γ ∈ Γ,
                                                        ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space),
                                                          v (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) = γ.1 (v z.1 z.2)) →
                                                    motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses.casesOn
declarations.type:
{C : Type} →
  {nE nM : ℕ} →
    {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} →
      {P : ℝ} →
        {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds} →
          {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
              {epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ} →
                {motive :
                    Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
                      Sort u} →
                  (t : Breakdown.CertCell.InstanceSplit.EnclosureAdmissibleClauses m P h W HW epsSup epsGradSup ratio) →
                    ((ampW_ge :
                          ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                        (ampGradW_ge :
                            ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                  h.ampGradW β y) →
                          (ampVort_ge :
                              ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                        (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                    h.ampVort β y) →
                            (ampGradVort_ge :
                                ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                          (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                      h.ampGradVort β y) →
                              (supVort_ge :
                                  ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                                (supGradVort_ge :
                                    ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                        h.supGradVort y) →
                                  (epsSpeed_ge :
                                      ∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                              (m.epsP β).frame •
                                                (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                  (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                          (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                    (muSpeed_ge :
                                        ∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                (m.muP β).frame •
                                                  (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                    (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                            (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                      (eps_oneSided :
                                          ∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                            ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                              ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                                Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                        (mu_oneSided :
                                            ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                              ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                  Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                          (mu_ratio :
                                              ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                    2 ≤
                                                  ratio *
                                                    ∑ β,
                                                      |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                        (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                            (ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ ratio) →
                                              (eps_sum_le : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                                (eps_grad_sum_le :
                                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                                  (conv_le :
                                                      ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                        m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                    motive ⋯) →
                      motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsExteriorCondition.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {mc : Breakdown.CertCell.ModeCharges} {mm : ℕ}
  {E : Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.ExteriorCondition C nE nM},
  E.pieces.IsValidOn m P h mm E.modes E.region →
    ((∃ R R₀ R₁,
          Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsDirectionRadius R R₀ R₁ ∧
            E.region = Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeRayRegion R ∧
              E.inverseSquareConst ≤ Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.rayInverseSquareConst E.pieces.azimuthLow) ∨
        ∃ R,
          0 < R ∧
            E.region = Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeSquareExterior R ∧
              E.inverseSquareConst ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ ι ∈ E.modes, Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth mm ι = 0) →
      0 < E.inverseSquareConst →
        E.charges.Covers mc E.modes E.region →
          (∀ p ∈ E.region, 0 ≤ (E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).hess) →
            (∀ p ∈ E.region,
                E.gradLow ≤ ((E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).charged E.charges p).gradFloor E.pieces.azimuthLow p.1) →
              (∀ p ∈ E.region,
                  Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeRadius p ^ 2 *
                      max (-((E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).charged E.charges p).vel) 0 ≤
                    E.velHigh) →
                (∀ p ∈ E.region,
                    Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.planeRadius p * ((E.pieces.lowCoef m h w p).charged E.charges p).cross ≤
                      E.crossHigh) →
                  0 ≤ E.velHigh →
                    0 ≤ E.crossHigh →
                      E.velHigh / E.inverseSquareConst + E.crossHigh / √E.inverseSquareConst ≤ E.gradLow →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.TailBand.IsExteriorCondition m P h w mc mm E

declarations.type:
∀ {rowCount : ℕ} {M : Breakdown.CertCell.CellMesh} {R : Breakdown.CertCell.RowValues M.count rowCount} {m : ℕ}
  {tauMax : ℝ},
  Breakdown.CertCell.IsCellMesh M →
    0 < m →
      (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a ∈ M.tested (R.cellOf a)) →
        (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.testOf a < R.testCount (R.cellOf a) (R.labelOf a)) →
          (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
              R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b →
                R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b → R.testOf a = R.testOf b → R.realPart a = R.realPart b → a = b) →
            (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, 0 < R.testWeight K ι) →
              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K ι ≤ tauMax) →
                (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, R.testWeight K (-ι) = R.testWeight K ι) →
                  (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                      ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                        R.testCount K (-ι) = R.testCount K ι ∧
                          ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                            ∀ (c : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K (-ι) i c) p =
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly.eval (M.box K) (R.testField K ι i c) p)) →
                    (∀ (a b : Fin rowCount),
                        R.cellOf a = R.cellOf b → R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf b → R.labelOf a = R.labelOf b) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin rowCount), R.labelOf a = -R.labelOf a → R.realPart a = true) →
                        (∀ (K : Fin M.count),
                            ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K,
                              ∀ i < R.testCount K ι,
                                ∀ (part : Bool),
                                  (ι = -ι → part = true) →
                                    ∃ a,
                                      R.cellOf a = K ∧
                                        (R.labelOf a = ι ∨ R.labelOf a = -ι) ∧ R.testOf a = i ∧ R.realPart a = part) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                              ↑p.1 * deriv (fun r => R.testValue M.box a 0 (r, p.2)) p.1 + R.testValue M.box a 0 p +
                                    Complex.I * ↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelAzimuth m (R.labelOf a)) *
                                      R.testValue M.box a 1 p +
                                  ↑p.1 * deriv (fun z => R.testValue M.box a 2 (p.1, z)) p.2 =
                                0) →
                            (∀ (a : Fin rowCount) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                (M.box (R.cellOf a)).IsAxis →
                                  p.1 = 0 → R.testValue M.box a 0 p = 0 ∧ R.testValue M.box a 1 p = 0) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin M.count), ∀ ι ∈ M.tested K, (R.testBlockMatrix M.box K ι).PosDef) →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.IsRowValues M R m tauMax

      (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet,

                  Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.ballPairing R.matchRadius
                    (Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.OffsetExpansionEntry.centreCoefficient D R Pr O)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.shapeInfoField Z.params (Z.field j)))| ≤
            O.centreErr j) →

                                S K x →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.quadFormValue (A.blocks K).pairingKept x ≤
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingExact D R K (Q K) x) →
                            (source_eq :
                                ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                  ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                    ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),

                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x p =

                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  1 / 2 *
                                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                      (Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairWeightOf x) ι p a b)
                                                0) →
                              (source_zero :
                                  ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                    ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.band K,
                                      ι ∉ R.pairLabels →
                                        ∀ (x : Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.CellVars D R K → ℂ),
                                          S K x →
                                            ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.linearField ((A.blocks K).pairingSource ι) x
                                                  p =
                                                0) →
                                (gamma_resolved :
                                    ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                      ∀ ι ∈ D.mesh.resolved K,
                                        ι ∈ R.pairLabels →
                                          (∃ g a b,
                                              ¬(fun p =>
                                                    R.pairProfile K g ι p a
                                                      b) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect]
                                                  0) →
                                            ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes ∧
                                              0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                                (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).pairingStrainCost ι ∧
                                                  ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),

                                                        ∑ b,

                                                            fun p =>
                                                            ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat
                                                                  (D.mesh.box K) p) *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b) ≤
                                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>
                                                        ↑(w g)) →
                                  (gamma_other :
                                      ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                        ∀ ι ∈ R.pairLabels,
                                          ι ∉ D.mesh.resolved K →
                                            ι ∉ D.mesh.band K →

                                                      (Q K).gammaWeight ι ≤ (A.blocks K).leakStrain ι ∧

                                                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in (D.mesh.box K).rect,

                                                                ∑ a,
                                                                  ∑ b,
                                                                    ‖Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.pairingProfile D R K
                                                                          (fun g => ↑(w g)) ι p a b‖ ^
                                                                      2 ≤
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι)
                                                              fun g => ↑(w g)) →
                                    (gamma_gram :
                                        ∀ (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
                                          ∀ ι ∈ (Q K).gammaModes,
                                            0 < (Q K).gammaWeight ι ∧
                                              ∀ (w : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                                0 ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm ((Q K).gammaGram ι) fun g =>

                                      (leak_nonneg :
